documents.text: Culture | Zibuke Africa · South Africa Zibuke Africa enables entrepreneurs and business owners to build companies that never fail. We own Success Led Selling, the technology that finds prospects and turns them into paying customers. We are paid only once the prospect we booked an appointment for becomes a paying customer. 🇿🇦 South Africa ▾ What We Stand On We do not talk accountability and commitment, we live by these rules . From the first employees we hire all the way to the revenue we generate for our clients, accountability and commitment are the foundations of how we behave. We prove with evidence everything we do before we ask to be paid, and our clients must generate revenue before we profit. The Principle Accountability is the ability to prove with evidence everything we do before we ask to be paid. Accountability is not a value we print on a wall. It is the ability to prove with evidence everything we do before we ask to be paid. Commitment is the discipline of staying until the result is real, not declaring a job finished before it works. Together they are the reason our payment depends on your success. Most companies ask you to pay for a promise. They ask you to trust that the work will be done, that the results will arrive, that the success will follow. Many of them sell unverified leads and empty promise lists, and you pay before a single customer pays you. We built this company to be the opposite. We deliver the evidence first. We prove the result. And only then do we ask to be paid. Our clients must generate revenue before we profit, and results are recognized only as money in your bank account. We take full operational risk on marketing and appointment generation. The autonomous agents search, find, engage, and book the appointments, and we are paid only once the prospect we booked an appointment for is converted into a paying customer. If the success is not real, we have not finished. That is the standard we hold ourselves to. Not activity reported. Not appointments booked. The only standard that matters is whether your business has generated revenue because of what we did, and whether we can prove it as money in your bank account. How Accountability And Commitment Show Up Where you can see the proof before the payment. We do not ask you to take our culture on faith. We built it into the structure of every engagement, so you can see exactly where accountability and commitment live. 1 Employee Selection Accountability and commitment govern how we hire. We select people who prove what they can do before they are appointed, and our Sales Representatives confirm their permanent appointment by closing three client contracts. We do not declare accountability in an interview. We demonstrate it by closing. 2 Practical Assessments Accountability governs our practical assessments. We give our people real work, real tools, and real prospects, and we judge them on the results they deliver, not on the answers they give. The standard is the same one our clients are held to: revenue, recognized as money in the bank. 3 Operational Execution Commitment governs our operational execution. We carry the operational risk on marketing and appointment generation. The autonomous agents work around the clock, and our team stays with the engagement until the prospects they book become paying customers. 4 Revenue Generation For Clients Our clients must generate revenue before we profit. We are paid only once the prospect we booked an appointment for becomes a paying customer. If your revenue does not arrive, our payment does not arrive. That alignment is the integrity of the entire model. 5 Evidence Instead Of Promises Our culture binds us to deliver proof and evidence instead of making promises. Every appointment booked, every connection made, and every paying customer delivered is captured and measured. The Trust Vault holds the proof, and the proof comes before the payment. 6 Accountability Is The Payment Structure Accountability is not a slogan. It is the payment structure itself. The proof comes first. The partnership follows. The payment only ever follows the proof, and it is recognized only as money in your bank account. Ubuntu The cultural principle we honour in South Africa . Our humanity is shared. Your success is our success until it is real. In South Africa we say ubuntu. I am because we are. That belief is the reason we deliver proof before payment. Your success and our success are tied together, and we do not profit until you generate revenue. We will not promise what we cannot deliver. We will prove what we deliver with evidence, and we will only ask to be paid after the proof is real. Switch countries at the top of this page. Each country we serve has its own cultural pillar. The Netherlands honours the poldermodel of shared decision making. Sweden honours lagom, the principle of just enough. Finland honours sisu, the quiet strength that finishes what others abandon. Choose your country and see how we adapt. What We Believe Convictions that shape every engagement. Proof and evidence, not promises. Our culture binds us to deliver proof and evidence instead of making promises. If we cannot prove it, we do not claim it. If we cannot measure it, we do not count it. Payment follows proof. We prove with evidence everything we do before we ask to be paid. That is the base of how we operate, and it is why our clients must generate revenue before we profit. Revenue is the only honest measure. Customers do not buy products. They buy the success those products enable. We measure that success as money in your bank account, and we are paid only once the prospect we booked becomes a paying customer. We do not profit until you generate revenue. Our motto is that we do not profit until you generate revenue. The commercial model is built so our income rises and falls with yours, because your revenue funds our relationship. Humans must talk to other humans. We deploy autonomous agents to search, find, engage, and book appointments, then connect each prospect to a human sales representative. The agents do the searching, and the humans do the talking. Unlock success for every customer. We desire to unlock success for every customer we serve. Where the product does not yet unlock success, our consulting services build the bridge, and then the paying customer follows. The Commitment We take full operational risk so you do not have to. Commitment means we carry the risk. We deploy the autonomous agents, we generate the visibility, we book the appointments, and we connect the prospects to human sales representatives. You pay only when a prospect becomes a paying customer. We grow brands through visibility and deploy autonomous agents that use context stored inside the client Trust Vault to deliver brand visibility and book appointments. We connect each prospect to a human sales representative because we believe humans must talk to other humans. And the proof that all of it works is recognized only as money in your bank account, before we ask to be paid. That is what accountability and commitment look like in practice. Not a promise of what we will do. Evidence of what we have already done, recognized as revenue in your business, before we ask for anything in return. If the revenue is not real, we have not finished. No payment. No obligation until the prospect becomes a paying customer. The proof that our methodology works is already standing in front of you, recognized as money in your bank account. Work With Us If this is the kind of partner you have been looking for, let us talk. The first conversation costs you nothing and commits you to nothing. Tell us what your business sells and who your customers are, and we will tell you honestly whether we can deploy autonomous agents, book appointments, and connect prospects to your human sales representatives. documents.title: The Five Foundations Of A Business That Never Fails | Zibuke Africa
documents.text: The Five Foundations Of A Business That Never Fails | Zibuke Africa Zibuke Africa enables entrepreneurs and business owners to build companies that never fail. We own Success Led Selling, the technology that finds prospects and turns them into paying customers. We are paid only once the prospect we booked an appointment for becomes a paying customer. 🇿🇦 South Africa ▾ The Five Foundations A business that never fails is built, one foundation at a time. Zibuke Africa enables entrepreneurs and business owners to build companies that never fail. Business is about transforming the lives of people, so five foundations decide whether your company survives: an organisational culture, a product or service that transforms the lives of your customers and your employees, created demand, the five types of numbers you understand deeply, and the political and legal environment you operate in. Take An Assessment See Consulting Services Why Zibuke Africa Exists Thirty years of failing in business taught one lesson. My name is Nyeka Mawabo. I failed in business for over thirty years until I learned that building a business is about transforming the lives of the people who are your employees and the people who are your customers. Today I am the founder of Zibuke Africa, a company that enables entrepreneurs and business owners to build businesses that never fail. Because I believe in Ubuntu Capitalism, I am going to share with you everything I know. What changed was not luck, capital, or a better market. What changed was understanding. Once I could see the five foundations clearly, and once I could see that every one of them is ultimately about transforming the life of a person, the business stopped failing. Building a business is harder now than it has ever been. There is an oversupply of businesses competing for the same few customers. Supply is greater than demand. When supply exceeds demand, doing what everyone else does is no longer enough. A business that never fails does not compete on effort. It is built on five foundations that a competitor cannot copy by working harder. The Five Foundations Five things, done properly, in this order. These are the five foundations of a business that never fails. Each foundation is a discipline you can build, measure, and improve. Together they are why a Zibuke Africa business does not depend on a founder's energy to survive. 01 Build An Organisational Culture Culture is what your people do when nobody is watching. A business that never fails has a culture of accountability and commitment, written down, taught to every hire, and measured in behaviour rather than slogans. We begin here because every other foundation is delivered by people, and people deliver what the culture permits. 02 Design A Product Or Service That Transforms Lives Your product or service must transform the life of the customer who buys it and the life of the employee who delivers it. When the customer's life is measurably better, price stops being the conversation. When the employee's life is measurably better, delivery stops being the risk. We design for transformation, not for features. 03 Create Demand Supply is greater than demand, so demand has to be created, not waited for. Creating demand means being visible to the people who already hold your customer's trust and attention, and giving them a reason to move. We show you the method, and where you prefer, we create the demand for you. 04 Understand Five Types Of Numbers Deeply An owner who does not understand the numbers is guessing. Five families of numbers tell the whole story of the business: the revenue numbers, the cost and margin numbers, the cash flow numbers, the customer numbers, and the productivity numbers. Deeply means you can explain each one without opening a report. 05 Understand Your Political And Legal Environment Every business operates inside a political and legal environment that decides what is permitted, what is protected, and what is taxed. Knowing that environment protects your company, your customers, and your people. It is the foundation most owners skip, and it is the one that closes businesses without warning. ✓ All Five, Or None Of Them A business with four foundations is a business waiting for the fifth to fail. Zibuke Africa assesses all five, then writes the order in which you build them, so effort goes where the risk actually is. Ubuntu Capitalism How your business transforms the lives of your customers and your employees. Ubuntu Capitalism is the belief that a business only becomes durable when it makes the lives of the people inside it and the people it serves measurably better. Profit is the proof that the transformation happened, never a substitute for it. How Your Business Transforms Your Customers A customer does not buy a product. A customer buys a different life: a problem gone, a cost removed, a fear answered, an income grown. Zibuke Africa helps you name that transformation in one sentence, prove it with evidence, and price it against the value of the changed life rather than the cost of your inputs. When the transformation is real, demand stops being a fight. When it is not real yet, no amount of selling will produce it, which is exactly why our consulting services exist. How Your Business Transforms Your Employees An employee who is transformed by the work delivers a transformed product. That means pay that is fair, skills that grow, a role that has meaning, and a culture where accountability is mutual: the employer keeps their promises and the employee keeps theirs. Zibuke Africa measures the employee experience with the same seriousness as the customer experience, because every customer transformation is delivered by a person whose own life is either improving or eroding. The transformation is the business. This is the difference between a business that survives and a business that never fails. A surviving business depends on the founder's energy. A business that never fails depends on people whose lives are genuinely better because the business exists, and who therefore carry it forward whether or not the founder is in the room. Start With An Assessment Take one assessment. Receive a free implementation plan. Take one of our three assessments and receive a free implementation plan that will result in the success of your business. Each assessment opens on Success Led Selling, the technology Zibuke Africa owns and operates, and each one ends with a plan you can follow with or without us. Where each assessment sends you. Every assessment button on this page leaves zibukeafrica.com and opens successledselling.co.za in a new tab, because the assessments and the autonomous agents that act on them live on the Success Led Selling platform. You can complete them yourself, or we complete them and act on your behalf. Join Us Three ways to build with Zibuke Africa. 1 Join The Zibuke Community Be part of the community where entrepreneurs are learning to build companies that never fail, and where the five foundations are taught openly because Ubuntu Capitalism shares what works. 2 Use Our Consulting Services Our existing consulting services address each of the five foundations directly: management training, product or service packaging, and operations and systems designs, priced per executive per year. See Consulting Services → 3 Deploy Success Led Selling Once your product genuinely transforms the life of your customer, we deploy autonomous agents that find prospects, book appointments, and connect them to human sales representatives. You pay only when a prospect becomes a paying customer. See Success Led Selling → Start Here Tell us which foundation is failing, and we will tell you the truth. One conversation. Tell us what your business sells, who your customers are, and which of the five foundations feels weakest. We will tell you honestly whether we can help, and which assessment to take first. It costs you nothing and commits you to nothing. Start A Conversation See Consulting Pricing

documents.text: Consulting Pricing | Purchasing Power Parity | Zibuke Africa Zibuke Africa enables entrepreneurs and business owners to build companies that never fail. We own Success Led Selling, the technology that finds prospects and turns them into paying customers. We are paid only once the prospect we booked an appointment for becomes a paying customer. 🇿🇦 South Africa ▾ Consulting Pricing · Purchasing Power Parity One price, converted to your country's purchasing power. We publish the consulting price, per executive per year, and we convert it to your country using purchasing power parity instead of a currency exchange rate. The result is deliberate: an executive in South Africa, an executive in Malaysia, and an executive in the United States each pay the same share of their income for the same work. Nobody subsidises anybody, and nobody is priced out by geography. Request Your Proposal See What Is Included Your Published Price The figure changes with the country you select. Use the country selector at the top of this page. The price below follows your selection and is the same figure that appears in your proposal. R42,000 Per Executive Per Year · ZAR Showing the published price for South Africa. R3,500 Per Executive Per Month · Twelve Installments Pay as a single annual payment, or split the same annual figure across twelve predictable monthly installments so your company cash flow is protected. What The Price Includes One enrollment. All three disciplines. The research publication. The per executive annual price is not a per discipline price. One enrolled executive receives the full set, so your leadership team is equipped across management, product, and operations at the same time. No software licensing fees. No setup fees. No monthly system subscriptions. Zibuke Africa is not a Software as a Service company. The per executive annual consulting price below covers the consultation work itself. Success Led Selling, our autonomous agent technology, is paid only once the prospect we booked an appointment for becomes a paying customer, and we do not charge for autonomous agents training if the customer and sales representative data we seek is provided. Every Country We Operate In The full purchasing power parity table. This is the published price for all fifteen countries Zibuke Africa operates in. The parity factor is the number of local currency units that buy the same basket of goods that one United States dollar buys in the United States. The base price is six thousand United States dollars per executive per year. Why the parity factor, and not the exchange rate. An exchange rate tells you what a currency is worth on the market. A purchasing power parity factor tells you what that money actually buys where you live. Pricing on parity means an executive enrolling from Malaysia is not paying a premium that only makes sense in New York, and an executive enrolling from Denmark is not receiving a discount that only makes sense in Rand. It is the same commitment to fairness that made us price results, not promises. Plan Your Enrollment How many executives do you want equipped? Enter the number of executives you intend to enroll. The figures below use the price for the country currently selected on this page, so the numbers match your proposal. Executives to enroll R42,000 1 executive × R42,000 per year. Or R3,500 per month across twelve months, so the annual commitment is paid in predictable installments. Every figure here is an indicative published price. Your proposal confirms the final amount, the executives enrolled, and the payment option that best protects your cash flow. Payment Options Two ways to pay. You choose. To protect your company cash flow, the same annual figure can be settled as a single annual payment or spread across twelve predictable monthly installments. Nothing changes about what your executives receive. Before You Pay Proposal In Writing The per executive annual price, the parity factor applied to your country, and your chosen payment option are written down and agreed before anything is invoiced. Month One Enrollment Begins Your executives are enrolled and begin unlimited consultation access across all three disciplines. Months One To Twelve Unlimited Access Management Training, Product or Service Packaging, and Operations and Systems Designs, applied to your exact commercial situation. During The Year Annual Research Publication The comprehensive annual research publication covering insights across all three consultation areas, delivered to your enrolled executives. Cancel Any Time Prorated Refund Cancel and receive a prorated refund for any months not yet delivered. See the refund and cancellation policies for the cooling off window in your country. Honest Limitations What this price does not include. Consulting is not a substitute for a product that transforms lives. If your product or service does not yet measurably improve the life of the customer who buys it, consulting is the work that gets you there. It is the route to Success Led Selling, not a replacement for it. Success Led Selling is priced differently, on purpose. Our autonomous agent work carries no software licensing fee, no setup fee, and no monthly subscription once the supportive training requirement is met. It is paid only once the prospect we booked an appointment for becomes a paying customer, because our clients must generate revenue before we profit. Parity factors are reviewed annually. The purchasing power parity factors used on this page are reviewed once a year and applied consistently across all fifteen countries. Your proposal states the factor applied to your country and the currency your invoice will be issued in. We would rather tell you the price than make you ask for it. Most consultancies hide the price until a proposal meeting. We publish it, because an entrepreneur building a business that never fails should be able to plan without guessing. Request your proposal → Start Here Enroll the executives who will build the business. One conversation. Tell us which executives you want equipped and which foundation is weakest, and we will confirm the price for your country, the payment option that protects your cash flow, and the order in which to build. documents.text: Success Led Selling | Zibuke Africa · South Africa Zibuke Africa enables entrepreneurs and business owners to build companies that never fail. We own Success Led Selling, the technology that finds prospects and turns them into paying customers. We are paid only once the prospect we booked an appointment for becomes a paying customer. 🇿🇦 South Africa ▾ Zibuke Africa's Proprietary Technology We deliver a paying customer to each of our clients. Zibuke Africa owns Success Led Selling, the technology that finds prospects and turns them into paying customers. We deploy autonomous agents that search, find, engage, and book appointments, then connect each prospect to a human sales representative because we believe humans must talk to other humans. We are paid per results, and results are recognized only as money in your bank account. Ubuntu Built for business leaders who measure success by revenue in the bank. In South Africa we say ubuntu because our shared humanity connects us deeply. That is the reason we prove with evidence everything we do before we ask to be paid, and why we do not profit until you generate revenue. Operating a business brings real daily pressure, so every engagement must deliver absolute security and financial certainty. We are not a Software as a Service company. We are paid only once the prospect we booked an appointment for is converted into a paying customer. We do not ask you to trust a promise. We prove with evidence everything we do before we ask to be paid, and we are paid only once the prospect we booked an appointment for becomes a paying customer. How We Deliver A Paying Customer Autonomous agents book the appointment. Humans close the customer. Success Led Selling is the technology Zibuke Africa owns, and it has one purpose: finding prospects and turning them into paying customers. We believe humans must talk to other humans. So we built a system where autonomous agents do the searching, finding, engaging, and booking, and human sales representatives do the talking, presenting, and closing. The agents create the visibility and the appointments. The humans create the paying customers. 01 Search, Find, And Engage Each autonomous agent searches for the prospects your business needs, finds the decision makers, and engages them with brand visibility built from the context stored inside the client Trust Vault. The agents work around the clock, on every channel, so no qualified prospect is missed. 02 Book The Appointment When a prospect is engaged, the autonomous agent books the appointment. The agent uses the Trust Vault context to make the appointment relevant, specific, and worth the prospect's time, so the conversation that follows starts with genuine interest. 03 Connect To A Human Sales Representative The booked prospect is connected to a human sales representative. The human takes the conversation, presents the proposition, answers the questions, and closes the sale. We believe humans must talk to other humans, because trust is built person to person, not machine to person. The prospect becomes a paying customer. Then we are paid. The sequence is the entire method. The autonomous agents search, find, engage, and book. The human sales representative connects and closes. The prospect becomes a paying customer. And only then, recognized as money in your bank account, are we paid. Every part of what we do exists to make that sequence happen. We Do Not Sell Leads We turn prospects into paying customers. That is all we sell. Many companies in the market sell leads, contact lists, and unverified appointment bookings. We do not sell any of those things. Our work focuses entirely on turning prospects into paying customers, and a result is recognized only when money is settled in your bank account by a customer we brought to your business. No Leads We do not sell lead lists. A list of names is not a result, and we would never charge you for names we have not converted. The only thing we sell is a paying customer. No Contact Lists We do not sell contact lists or databases of decision makers. We find prospects, engage them, and book the appointment, and we carry the full operational risk of that work. No Unverified Bookings We do not sell unverified appointment bookings. The appointments our autonomous agents produce are real, relevant, and connected to proof, and they end with a paying customer or they are not finished. We are compensated only when a prospect becomes a paying customer. We are paid only once the prospect we booked an appointment for is converted into a paying customer who deposits money into your bank account. We carry the full operational risk of finding and engaging prospects, because that is the commitment we live by. The Trust Vault The context every autonomous agent uses. Each autonomous agent uses context stored inside the client Trust Vault to deliver brand visibility and book appointments. The Trust Vault is the evidence engine that holds the proof of customer success, and it is the reason every appointment booked and every connection made traces back to something real. Real Evidence, Not Invention The Trust Vault holds measured results, customer outcomes, narrative stories, and third party validations. The autonomous agents draw from this evidence to deliver brand visibility, so every message and every appointment is grounded in proof, never in invention. Visibility That Triggers Interest The autonomous agents repackage the Trust Vault context into content and responses designed to trigger interest, around the clock, on every channel. Each piece of visibility points back to a real customer success, so the prospect who engages already has a reason to talk. Appointments Worth Taking Because the agents book from context that is real and relevant, the appointments they book start with genuine interest, not cold interruption. The human sales representative receives a prospect who is already engaged, which is why the conversations convert into paying customers. The Trust Vault grows with every paying customer. Every prospect who becomes a paying customer adds new evidence to the Trust Vault, which makes the next autonomous agent more credible, the next appointment more relevant, and the next paying customer easier to deliver. Never chase a contractor. Your home, on complete autopilot. We serve customers wherever they are in South Africa, even if you have never used us before. The Problem We Solve: Home Maintenance in South Africa Is Broken A broken fridge sits for weeks because nobody has a bakkie to move it. A dripping geyser means a week of phone calls and contractors who never show up. A tripped DB board means a stranger from the internet with a toolbox, a vague quote and no certificate. South African homeowners are done with heavy lifting, unvetted contractors, surprise repair fees and the chaos of chasing three different trades. Zibuke OnCall ends all of it. One trusted, on-call concierge team for your appliances, electrical, plumbing, handyman and lawn. We serve you wherever you are in South Africa, even if you have never used us before, and our accountability compels us to do what we said we will do. The Old Way vs The On-Call Concierge Way Service / Issue Type Typical Emergency Repair Cost Zibuke OnCall Concierge Plan Emergency Electrician Callout R600 to R1,500 Included in Electrical Plan (R2,900/yr) Emergency Plumber Callout R500 to R3,500 Included in Plumbing Plan (R3,300/yr) Washing Machine Repair R800 to R3,500 Included in Appliance Plans (from R259/mo) Fridge Compressor Replacement R2,500 to R7,000 Included in Appliance Plans (from R259/mo) Geyser Replacement & Fitment R4,000 to R12,000 Included in Plumbing Plan (R3,300/yr) Our Solution: One Concierge. Complete Home Autopilot. Five on-call services for homeowners, plus a separate homeowner-only Landscaping Programme, all under one trusted subscription with zero surprise fees. 🔧 Appliance Plans We come to your home, collect your appliance, repair it at our workshop and deliver it back working. You never lift a finger, even on your first visit. ⚡ Electrical Plan A licensed wireman at your door within 5 hours, with a legal Certificate of Compliance. One phone call, one trusted team. 🚿 Plumbing Plan A PIRB-registered master plumber on-site within 5 hours. Emergencies handled, with no surprise fees. 🔨 Handyman Plan 12 scheduled visits a year for roof leaks, doors, locks and cupboards. We come to you, on a schedule you can rely on. 🌿 Landscaping Programme (Homeowners Only) Green all year round is the result. Monthly bio-manure nutrition treatments keep your home lawn green all year. We handle the care, you enjoy the garden. ⏸️ Your home running smoothly? Your payment pauses. Your on-call priority stays 100% active. You only pay when you actually call us in. Our Accountability Culture: The Foundation of Everything We Do Accountability is not a policy we post on a wall. It is not a slogan we print on T-shirts. Accountability is the operating system of Zibuke OnCall. Every person who joins Zibuke OnCall, whether a sales representative, technician, driver, or manager, must demonstrate accountability through measurable results before they are permanently hired. And every employee continues to demonstrate it every single day. This is how we guarantee that the promises we make to our customers are kept. What Accountability Means at Zibuke OnCall 1. Doing what you say you will do When we promise a 5-hour emergency response, we deliver. When we promise to repair your appliance, we repair it. When we promise to keep your service active during payment pause, we keep it active. 2. Being honest about what you have and have not done We do not hide delays. We do not make excuses. We tell you exactly what is happening with your repair, your delivery, and your service. Transparency is our commitment. 3. Taking ownership of your results, good or bad When a repair is completed perfectly, we own the success. When a delivery is late, we own the failure. Every person at Zibuke OnCall is accountable for their own results. 4. Demonstrating your commitment through measurable actions We do not measure accountability by intentions. We measure it by results. Sales representatives must sell a minimum number of packages. Technicians must complete repairs without callbacks. Drivers must deliver on time. Numbers do not lie. 5. Being reliable. People can count on you. Our customers trust us because we show up. Our employees trust us because we pay fairly. Our partners trust us because we deliver on our promises. Reliability is the foundation of every relationship we build. How Accountability Operates Across Every Department Accountability is not a slogan on a wall. It is the operating system of Zibuke OnCall across every role. Department Role How They Demonstrate Accountability Measured By Revenue Sales Representative Sells minimum 20 packages per month to qualify for bonus. If they miss, they own it. No excuses. Monthly package count, assessment progress, bars earned Revenue Sales Manager Ensures at least 3 of their reps hit their 20-package benchmark. Manages team accountability. Team hit rate, 3-of-team rule compliance, tiered bonuses earned Revenue Regional Sales Manager Sells corporate maintenance contracts using free comprehensive maintenance assessment report. Owns pipeline. Corporate contracts signed, pipeline value, monthly contract revenue Operations Technician Completes repairs correctly the first time. Quality of work is their accountability. No callbacks. Repairs completed, callback rate, repair quality score Logistics Driver Arrives on time. Handles appliances with care. Reliable delivery is their accountability. Jobs completed on time, delivery damage rate, reliability score Operations Supervisor Ensures their team delivers quality results. Their team's performance is their accountability. Team output, quality metrics, customer satisfaction Operations Intern (Operations) Completes logbook activities. Rotates between managers. Demonstrates growth through actions. Logbook completion, rotation feedback, skill development Logistics Logistics Manager Coordinates all collection and delivery operations. Ensures drivers meet their targets and appliances are handled with care. Fleet performance, on-time delivery rate, customer satisfaction Logistics Intern (Logistics) Completes logbook activities. Supports drivers and logistics managers. Demonstrates reliability through actions. Logbook completion, task completion, supervisor feedback Leadership Master / CEO Builds and monitors the entire accountability system. Ensures the culture is maintained at every level. Makes final decisions on hiring, promotion, and demotion. System integrity, culture adherence, organisational performance Two Accountability Systems: One for Candidates, One for Employees 1. The Accountability Assessment (for Candidates) Every person who joins Zibuke OnCall, whether Sales Manager, Sales Representative, Intern, Technician, or Driver, must prove they are accountable before they are permanently hired. The assessment is not a test. It is a demonstration. Sales candidates must sell 45 active subscriptions. Technicians must complete 48 repairs without callback. Drivers must complete 70 collection and delivery jobs on time. If they succeed, they are hired permanently. If they fail, they are released with what they earned. 2. The Accountability Score (Bars) (for Employees) After passing their assessment, employees earn bars for exceeding their monthly targets. Bars determine their annual bonus. Sales representatives earn 1 bar per package sold above 20 per month. Sales managers earn 1 bar per 3 extra packages sold above target by their team. Both systems are tracked automatically and displayed in each employee's portal. Our Accountability to Customers: We Keep Our Promises Accountability extends beyond employees to customers. When you subscribe to Zibuke OnCall, the company makes a promise: your appliances will be repaired quickly, correctly, and with care. This promise is demonstrated through: Service Level Commitments 5-hour emergency response for electrical and plumbing, next business day for handyman, 3-hour emergency response for corporate customers. Repair Transparency Track your appliance repair in real-time through the portal, with seven distinct statuses from Received to Delivered. Proactive Notifications Payment reminders, repair status updates, and delivery scheduling. You are notified before you have to ask. The Loyalty Discount Customers who remain claim-free earn increasing discounts on their subscription, eventually reaching R0 per month. The Payment Pause Feature If you don't use the service, your payment is paused while the service stays active. This is the ultimate accountability: we only charge you when you need us. The Payment Pause Difference: We Only Charge You When You Need Us For monthly plans: your payment is paused after the first month if you have not used the service, and resumes only after your first repair. For annual plans: your payment is paused if you have not used the service, and resumes only after your first repair. Your service stays active even when your payment is paused. You can still book oncall, request repairs, and use all portal features. 📅 Month 1 Pay and subscribe. Your plan is active. ⏸️ Month 2 Onwards Payment paused if no service used. Service stays active. 🔧 When You Need Us Payment resumes. Repair is completed. You only pay when you use it. This is our accountability to you: we will not take your money if we are not providing you with value. Our Service Commitments: Measurable Promises We Keep Every service type comes with explicit SLAs backed by our accountability culture. Service Type Customer Type Response Time Details Electrical Emergency Homeowner 5 hours Registered Wireman onsite within 5 hours of booking Plumbing Emergency Homeowner 5 hours PIRB-registered plumber onsite within 5 hours of booking Landscape Maintenance Homeowner Scheduled visits Monthly or twice-monthly scheduled visits with all year round green grass maintenance Handyman Homeowner Next business day Qualified handyman onsite next business day Appliance Repair Homeowner Collection within 48 hours We collect, repair, and deliver your appliance Corporate Emergency Corporate 3 hours Onsite within 3 hours of first report for any asset under contract Corporate Standard Corporate Per SLA tier Response time depends on retainer tier: 24h, 12h, or 4h Part of Zibuke Africa Zibuke OnCall is a unit within the Services Division of Zibuke Africa. The parent company provides the broader infrastructure and strategic direction, while Zibuke OnCall focuses on being South Africa's on-demand home concierge. One trusted team ends the frustration, distrust and chaos of traditional home maintenance. Zibuke Africa's mission is to build companies that serve South African communities with accountability, transparency, and measurable results. Zibuke OnCall is one expression of that mission. White-glove logistics, certified technical mastery, zero-risk guarantees and the revolutionary Payment Pause. Ready to Put Your Home on Complete Autopilot? Join the South African families who never lift a finger and never chase a contractor. One subscription. One trusted team. Your home, handled. We serve customers wherever they are in South Africa, even if you have never used us before. Choose Your Plan Request Corporate Assessment

documents.title: Master Practice Modules | Zibuke OnCall Training
documents.text: Master Practice Modules | Zibuke OnCall Training 📞 Enquiries: +27 18 007 0525 📍 Contact Us 📋 Training 📋 Package Plans TRAINING PROGRAMME MASTER PRACTICE MODULES Turn your hands into a profession. No experience needed. No formal qualifications required. In 6 months you go from a complete beginner to a skilled apprentice earning a monthly stipend. You only need a Grade 9 pass and a willingness to learn. 📌 Workplace Preparation: This is a 6-month internal workplace preparation programme. It is not a formal NQF qualification. Successful completion grants you entry into our 4-year paid Apprenticeship Programme where you prepare for the National Trade Test. Your final accreditation comes from the State when you pass that test, not from us. We operate within full legal compliance. Your Career Starts Here Have you ever wanted to build a lifelong career that no recession can take away? The electronic repair industry desperately needs skilled artisans in South Africa. Zibuke OnCall built this programme to bridge the gap between having no qualifications and becoming a certified artisan. You do not need a background in engineering. You do not need years of university study. You only need a Grade 9 certificate, a strong work ethic, and the willingness to learn with your hands. We take you from there. Our Master Practice Modules is a 6-month immersion programme designed to change how you understand electronics. You are not sitting in a lecture hall taking notes. You are on the workshop floor observing Master Craftsmen and performing hands on repairs on stoves, fridges, washing machines, and more. When you finish the 6 months, you are guaranteed entry into our 4-year Apprenticeship Programme. As an apprentice, you earn R4,500 per month while you continue learning. At the end, you write the National Trade Test and become a legally certified artisan. Why Choose This Path Zero Experience Needed We teach you from the ground up. You start with safety and tool handling and progress to complex repairs on every major appliance type. Guaranteed Career Progression Complete the 6-month module and you are guaranteed entry into our 4-year paid Apprenticeship Programme. Earn While You Learn As an accepted apprentice you earn R4,500 per month while you master your trade and prepare for the National Trade Test. National Certification We support you through the National Trade Test. You become a legally certified artisan recognised by the State. Accessible Payment Plans Start your journey with R950. Pay off your practical training in manageable monthly installments of R3,200. Real Workshop Experience You learn at our workshop with real tools, real parts, and real appliances. Master Craftsmen guide you every step. Accountability Culture Built Into Your Training Accountability is not a separate test you take after the Master Practice Modules. It is woven into every day of your training from the moment you start. You do not learn accountability by reading a document. You learn it by practicing it daily for 6 months. From week 1 you are taught to show up on time, document every repair honestly, take ownership of your mistakes, and ask for help when you need it. Your Master Craftsman holds you to this standard every day. When you make a mistake you do not hide it. You report it, you learn from it, and you fix it. This is how we build the accountability culture that defines Zibuke OnCall. By the time you complete the 6-month programme, accountability is not something you think about. It is simply how you work. You carry this habit into the 4-year Apprenticeship Programme and then into your career as a certified artisan. When you become an apprentice, you do not go through a separate Accountability Assessment. You have already proven your character through 6 months of daily demonstration. Your portfolio of repairs, your honesty in documenting mistakes, and your consistency in showing up are your proof. What Accountability Means in Practice: You arrive at the workshop on time every day. You log every repair you attempt including the ones you could not complete. You admit when you break a part and you help find a solution. You do not blame tools or other people. You own your results. This is not a policy. It is the standard you agree to when you join the Master Practice Modules. Your 6-Month Journey Each month builds on the last. You start with the basics and progress to independent troubleshooting. By month 6 you are diagnosing and repairing appliances on your own under Master supervision. Month 1 Safety and Foundations Workshop safety induction, tool handling, and observing Master Craftsmen on basic electrical fault finding. Introduction to electric stoves, replacing heating elements, switches, and terminal block wiring. Month 2 Ovens and Microwaves Electric ovens, diagnosing thermostats, replacing fan motors, understanding oven wiring schematics. Microwave ovens, high voltage safety protocols, testing magnetrons, replacing door interlock switches. Month 3 Washing Machines Disassembling chassis, inspecting motor carbon brushes, replacing drive belts. Diagnosing water inlet valves, drain pumps, and basic electronic control board observation. Month 4 Refrigerators Understanding the refrigeration cycle, testing compressor terminals, replacing start relays. Brazing techniques, gas leak detection, replacing defrost heaters and bi-metal thermostats. Month 5 Small Appliances and Diagnostics Repairing kettles, toasters, and blenders. Practicing rapid component-level soldering. Cross-appliance diagnostics using multimeters and insulation resistance testers across all observed appliance types. Month 6 Assessment and Transition Independent troubleshooting on faulty appliances. Advanced practical assessments with full teardowns and reassemblies. Logbook and evidence compilation. Final evaluation and Master Craftsman approval for transition into the 4-year paid Apprenticeship Programme. Your Investment The total cost of the Master Practice Modules is R20,000. Choose the payment option that works for your budget. Application Fee R950 Non-refundable once reviewed Paid once when you apply Triggers Master review Refundable only if we cancel before reviewing Required to start process Pay R950 Application fee Most Popular Installment Plan R3,200 per month for 5 months R950 application + R4,000 registration 5 monthly payments of R3,200 First payment at end of month 1 Total R20,000 Pay R4,000 Registration Registration unlocks your Learner Portal Upfront Payment R17,500 Save R2,500 No registration fee needed R950 application fee still applies Immediate full portal access Total saving of R2,500 Pay R17,500 Waives R4,000 registration fee How Payments Work Step 1: You pay R950 application fee when you submit your application. This fee is non-refundable once we begin reviewing your application, whether it is approved or rejected. If we cancel the programme before processing your application, you receive a full refund. Step 2: If the Master approves your application, you pay R4,000 to secure your workshop placement. This unlocks your Learner Portal where you access course materials and start documenting your learning. Step 3: At the end of month 1 you pay your first installment of R3,200. This repeats at the end of months 2, 3, 4, and 5. Option: Instead of steps 2 and 3 you can pay R17,500 upfront. This waives the R4,000 registration fee and gives you immediate full access to your Learner Portal. You save R2,500. Important: Application fees are R950 and are non-refundable once we begin reviewing your application. Registration fees are R4,000 and are refundable only if Zibuke OnCall cancels your placement. Installment payments of R3,200 are due at the end of each month from month 1 to month 5. Late payments may result in suspension of portal access until the account is brought up to date. Legal Compliance Notice: The law prohibits institutions from falsely advertising and issuing their own National Qualifications. The Master Practice Modules is an internal Workplace Preparation programme. It is not a formal NQF qualification. The ultimate accreditation is granted by the State when you pass the National Trade Test at the end of the 4-year Apprenticeship Programme. The evidence you gather in your Learner Portal serves as the required logbook and workplace evidence to apply for the trade test via the Apprenticeship or Recognition of Prior Learning pathways. Zibuke OnCall operates within full legal compliance. Your Journey Step by Step 1 You Apply You submit your application below with your details and proof of Grade 9 or higher. You pay the R950 application fee. The Master reviews your application. If you meet the requirements you are accepted. 2 You Register Once accepted you pay the R4,000 registration fee to secure your workshop placement. This unlocks your Learner Portal where you can access theory notes and connect with your assigned Master Craftsman. 3 You Complete the 6-Month Programme You attend the workshop, observe Master Craftsmen, and perform hands on repairs. Each month covers a different appliance type. You document everything in your Learner Portal with photos, notes, and voice recordings. You track your progress with a visual month counter. 4 You Are Approved as an Apprentice After month 6 the Master evaluates your portfolio and approves your transition into the 4-year Apprenticeship Programme. You now earn R4,500 per month while continuing to learn and prepare for the National Trade Test. 5 You Become a Certified Artisan After 4 years of apprenticeship you write and pass the National Trade Test. You are now a legally certified Electronic Appliance Repair Artisan recognised by the State. Your career is secured for life. Ready for the Next Step? After you complete the Master Practice Modules, you can apply for our 4-year Apprenticeship Programme. You earn R4,500 per month adjusted for inflation every year. You train at our workshop using the German Dual VET model. You prepare for the National Trade Test and become a certified artisan. Read all the details on the apprenticeship page. View the Apprenticeship → The Master Practice Modules is the only entry point to the Apprenticeship Programme Apply for the Master Practice Modules You need a Grade 9 pass or higher and you must be 16 years or older to apply. Application fees are R950 and are non-refundable once we begin reviewing your application. Fill in your details below to start your journey. ✅ APPLICATION SUBMITTED Hi , Thank you for applying to the Master Practice Modules at Zibuke OnCall . Our Master Craftsman will review your application within 5 business days. Application reference: Course: Master Practice Modules Your R950 application fee has been received. You can track your application status at any time using your reference number. If you are accepted, you will be invited to pay the R4,000 registration fee to secure your workshop placement and unlock your Learner Portal. Track your application at: zibukeoncall.co.za/track-application.html The Zibuke OnCall training team Queries: [email�protected] | Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM SAST ← Back to Careers Hub

documents.title: Appliance Repair Apprenticeship | Zibuke OnCall
documents.text: Appliance Repair Apprenticeship | Zibuke OnCall 📞 Enquiries: +27 18 007 0525 📍 Contact Us 📋 Training 📋 Package Plans PAID APPRENTICESHIP 4 YEAR APPRENTICESHIP A structured 4-year programme inspired by the German Dual Vocational Education and Training system. You spend 70 percent of your time doing real repairs at our workshop. You spend 30 percent in structured theory. At the end you write the South African National Trade Test and become a certified artisan for life. Apply Now ↓ Entrance Requirement: You must have completed the 6-month Master Practice Modules at Zibuke Africa before you can be accepted into this apprenticeship. There are no exceptions. Read the full requirement below. You Earn Every Month R4,500 Your stipend is adjusted every year for inflation. You start at R4,500 per month in year 1. In year 2 it rises with the official inflation rate. The same applies for year 3 and year 4. Your income grows while you learn, and your purchasing power is protected. Your Path Starts Here You cannot apply for the Apprenticeship Programme unless you have completed the Master Practice Modules at Zibuke Africa. This 6-month workplace preparation course is the only entry point we recognise. It teaches you everything you need to succeed as an apprentice. If you have not completed the Master Practice Modules, click the button below to start your journey. Complete the 6-month programme and you will be guaranteed entry into this apprenticeship. Apply for Master Practice Modules → Start with the 6-month workplace preparation course. Your apprenticeship awaits. Inspired by the German Dual VET System The German Dual Vocational Education and Training system is one of the most respected apprenticeship models in the world. It produces highly skilled artisans who are valued globally. We have adapted this model for South Africa while keeping its core strengths. In the German system, apprentices spend about 70 percent of their time working in a real commercial environment and 30 percent receiving theoretical instruction. We follow the same structure. You work at our workshop performing real repairs on real appliances for paying customers. You also attend structured theory sessions that build your understanding of electronics, diagnostics, and safety protocols. The German system is overseen by the Chambers of Industry and Commerce who administer the final trade test. In our system, the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations sets the standard, and the National Trade Test is the final examination you must pass. The result is the same. You become a legally certified artisan recognised by the State. How the 70/30 Split Works 🔧 70% Practical Work You work at our workshop repairing real appliances that belong to paying customers. Your Master Craftsman supervises you and signs off on every repair you complete. You build real experience that prepares you for the National Trade Test. 📖 30% Theory Instruction You attend structured theory sessions covering electronics fundamentals, diagnostic methodology, safety regulations, and appliance-specific technical knowledge. These sessions prepare you for the written and oral components of the trade test. 📋 RPL Portfolio Building Every repair you complete becomes evidence in your Recognition of Prior Learning portfolio. You document each job with photos, notes, and voice recordings. This portfolio is submitted when you apply for the National Trade Test. 🏭 Workshop Based Training You are based at our workshop where you have access to all the tools, parts, and appliances you need. You learn alongside other apprentices and under the direct supervision of experienced Master Craftsmen. Your 4 Year Journey Each year builds on the last. You start with supervised basic repairs and progress to independent complex diagnostics. By year 4 you are preparing for the National Trade Test and supervising new learners. 1 Foundation Year Building Your Basics You work under close supervision on basic repairs. Stoves, microwaves, and simple electrical fault finding. You build your logbook with evidence of at least 50 repairs. You attend theory sessions on safety, tool handling, and basic electronics. 2 Independence Year Working on Your Own You handle common appliances with minimal supervision. Washing machines, tumble dryers, and refrigerators become your focus. You learn brazing, gas handling, and advanced diagnostics. Your logbook grows to over 150 repairs. 3 Advanced Year Complex Diagnostics You tackle complex electronic systems on modern appliances. You learn to diagnose control boards, inverter systems, and networked appliances. You begin supervising year 1 apprentices under Master guidance. Your logbook exceeds 300 repairs. 4 Trade Test Year Final Preparation You compile your final RPL portfolio for the National Trade Test application. You take mock trade tests under timed conditions. You present your diagnostic logic in oral discussions. You sit for the National Trade Test and become a certified artisan. The National Trade Test The National Trade Test is the final examination that qualifies you as an Electronic Appliance Repair Artisan. It is administered by the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations and recognised by the State. The test has three parts. Practical You execute a real repair under timed conditions. The examiners assess your technique, safety compliance, and final result. Written You answer rigorous theoretical questions covering electronics, safety, and appliance-specific knowledge. Oral You defend your diagnostic logic to examiners. You explain what you found, how you diagnosed it, and why you chose your repair method. When you pass all three parts, you receive your National Certificate and become a legally certified artisan for life. This certification is recognised throughout South Africa and opens doors to senior roles, business ownership, and international opportunities. Accountability Culture in Your Apprenticeship Accountability is the foundation of everything we do at Zibuke OnCall. You experience this culture from your first day in the Master Practice Modules. It does not begin when you become an apprentice. It begins when you start your training. During the Master Practice Modules, you are taught what accountability means in a practical sense. You show up on time. You document every repair honestly. You take ownership of your mistakes. You ask for help when you need it and you help others when they need it. These habits are built into the structure of the 6-month programme. By the time you enter the apprenticeship, accountability is already part of who you are. You do not need a separate Accountability Assessment for the apprenticeship because you have already proven yourself through the Master Practice Modules. The culture is embedded in every day of your training. It is not a test you take. It is a way you work. This is how we ensure every apprentice who joins our programme has the discipline and honesty required to succeed. You do not learn accountability from a document. You learn it by practicing it every day for 6 months before you even apply for the apprenticeship. What You Get as an Apprentice 💰 R4,500 Monthly Stipend You earn while you learn. Your stipend is adjusted for inflation every year so your income keeps pace with the cost of living. 🎓 National Trade Test Preparation We prepare you thoroughly for all three parts of the trade test. Mock tests, portfolio compilation, and oral practice sessions. 🛠️ Real Workshop Experience You work on real appliances for real customers. Your experience is genuine and your skills are proven through actual repairs. 📈 Career Advancement Certified artisans can advance to Master Craftsman, Technical Manager, Workshop Manager, and beyond. Your apprenticeship is the start of a lifelong career. Your Complete Path to Certification 1 Complete the Master Practice Modules You attend our 6-month workplace preparation programme. You learn the foundations of appliance repair. You build accountability into your work habits. You prove you are ready for the apprenticeship. This is the only way to qualify for the programme. Apply for MPM → 2 The Master Approves Your Transition After you complete month 6 of the Master Practice Modules, the Master Craftsman evaluates your portfolio and your progress. If you meet the standard, you are approved to transition into the 4-year Apprenticeship Programme. This approval is based on evidence, not opinion. 3 You Complete the 4-Year Apprenticeship You work 70 percent of your time at our workshop and attend 30 percent theory instruction. You build your RPL portfolio. You progress through each year with increasing independence. Your stipend grows with inflation. You prepare for the National Trade Test. 4 You Pass the National Trade Test You write and pass the National Trade Test administered by the Quality Council for Trades and Occupations. You become a legally certified Electronic Appliance Repair Artisan. Your certification is recognised by the State. Your career is secured for life. Apply for the Apprenticeship ✅ Master Practice Modules Verified Welcome back, . Complete the form below to submit your apprenticeship application. ✅ APPLICATION SUBMITTED Hi , Your application for the Apprenticeship Programme has been received. Our Master Craftsman will verify your Master Practice Modules reference and contact you within 7 business days. Application reference: Programme: 4-Year Appliance Repair Apprenticeship The Zibuke OnCall training team Queries: [email�protected] | Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM SAST ← Back to Careers Hub
