documents.text: Sales Manager | Zibuke OnCall 📞 Enquiries: +27 18 007 0525 📍 Contact Us 📋 Package Plans ACCOUNTABILITY ASSESSMENT PATHWAY SALES MANAGER We hire managers to lead people, not only to sell. Your Sales Manager Accountability Assessment has changed. You no longer sell 45 packages yourself. You build and lead a local team of Sales Representative candidates, and you pass only when 12 of them have each sold 45 fixed repair plans and graduated through their own assessment. You earn commission on every repair plan your representatives sell along the way (8% Silver / 10% Gold / 12% Platinum of the net subscription value). Once you pass, your permanent role begins with a guaranteed R16,000 monthly basic salary and a monthly bonus when 3 of your representatives reach their monthly target, plus an annual bonus calculated from your accountability score bars. Apply Now ↓ ⏰ Your Working Hours Wednesday to Sunday • 9 hours per day • Monday & Tuesday off About This Role Zibuke OnCall is building its national footprint one local team at a time, and we protect our culture of accountability by choosing the manager first. Your Sales Manager Accountability Assessment is no longer a personal selling test. You will not be asked to sell 45 repair packages yourself. We made that change because managers who proved personal selling ability were still struggling to lead the teams they were handed. Your assessment now tests leadership itself. You will build a local team of Sales Representative candidates from your own community, and you will graduate them through their own 45-package assessment. You pass only when 12 of your representatives have each sold 45 fixed repair plans and passed their own assessment. Leading people is harder than selling to them, and this assessment is built to prove you can do it. Once you graduate 12 representatives and pass your assessment, you are confirmed as a permanent Sales Manager. Your core team is built around the representatives you graduated. Your ongoing monthly bonus is earned when 3 of your core representatives reach their monthly target, and your annual bonus is calculated from your accountability score bars. Your main responsibility is keeping your team's customer portfolios active and growing. Your R16,000 monthly basic salary is funded by the revenue their portfolios generate. When some of your representatives consistently underperform, you step in, coach them, and protect the team's results. You can do this confidently because you have already led real people through the same path they walked. Your role with interns is to supervise and guide them toward completing their logbook workplace experience. Interns do not carry performance targets like your Sales Representatives do. They focus on completing the activities their diploma requires. The sales your interns generate add a monthly performance bonus to your earnings, but only when your core team also performs. You can read more about this in the Bonus Structure section below. 📋 How Your Sales Manager Assessment Works Step 1: You submit your application using the form on this page. Step 2: Before you begin, you submit your certified South African ID and certified proof of the bank account held in your own name. No candidate starts without these documents. Step 3: Once we verify your documents, we issue you an official Zibuke OnCall email address and hand you the tailored job advert you will place in your own community. Step 4: You register an employer account on Indeed or SA Youth using our CIPC registration number, the Zibuke Africa company name, our sector, and your Zibuke OnCall email as the valid corporate email. You post one advert for the Sales Representative role, based on the town or township you live in. Step 5: You build and lead your local team of Sales Representative candidates, earning commission on every repair plan they sell (8% Silver / 10% Gold / 12% Platinum of the net subscription value), until 12 of them graduate through their own 45-package assessment. Step 6: When 12 have graduated, you pass your assessment and you are confirmed as a permanent Sales Manager. You then earn a R16,000 monthly basic salary, a monthly bonus when 3 of your representatives reach their monthly target, and an annual bonus calculated from your accountability score bars. 📍 One Advert For Your Own Community You post only one advert, and it must be based on the town or township where you currently live. You may place it on Indeed or on SA Youth, not both. You become the authorised person for Zibuke OnCall in your area, and the work opportunities you create grow from your own community. If another sales manager candidate already covers your area, we do not allow a second employer account on these platforms. Instead, the candidate who already holds the account places a new advert for you. This keeps our presence clean, local, and honest. If you hit a wall and need guidance at any point, send an email to [email protected] and we will respond and assist you. 💰 REMUNERATION AND BASIC SALARY Basic Salary: R16,000.00 per month. Guaranteed. Your Role After the Assessment: You passed the Accountability Assessment. You proved you can lead. As a permanent Sales Manager, your responsibility is to manage the accountability of others. Your core team of 12 sales representatives looks to you as the example of what accountability looks like in practice. Your monthly performance bonus is more than income. It is proof that you are managing your team's accountability effectively. How Your Salary is Funded: Your salary is funded by the active, paying customer portfolios your team builds. This is the natural result of a team that lives by the accountability culture you lead. 📌 Ramp-Up Period: In the first 2 to 3 months of a newly formed team, the portfolio may not generate enough revenue to fully cover your R16,000 salary. During this phase, the company covers the difference from its reserves. Once the team's monthly recurring revenue builds, the team funds itself entirely. This includes your salary and all 12 reps' salaries. How the Assessment Works: To be hired as a Sales Manager, you first complete the Sales Manager Accountability Assessment. Before you begin, you submit your certified ID and certified proof of bank account. Once we verify them, we issue your Zibuke OnCall email and your tailored advert. You register an employer account on Indeed or SA Youth using our CIPC registration number, the Zibuke Africa company name, our sector, and your Zibuke OnCall email. You post one advert, based on the town or township where you live, to attract Sales Representative candidates from your own community. You earn commission on every repair plan your assigned representatives sell (8% Silver / 10% Gold / 12% Platinum of the net subscription value). You manage up to fifty assigned candidates, and you pass only when 12 of them have each sold 45 fixed repair plans and graduated. Your assessment runs for three months. It is extended by a single month if, at the end of the third month, at least 8 of your sales representatives have reached their targets. During the assessment your income is the commission your team's sales generate. Once you pass, you are confirmed as a permanent Sales Manager on a guaranteed R16,000 monthly basic salary, with a monthly bonus when 3 of your representatives reach their monthly target, plus an annual bonus calculated from your accountability score bars. The form below is where you start. Submitting it registers you as a candidate and begins the conversation with leadership. 📈 Your Bonus Structure Your bonus is a direct measure of how well you manage your team's accountability. It proves you are leading your team effectively, month after month. The 3-of-Team Standard You earn your monthly bonus in any month where at least 3 of your core Sales Representatives reach their monthly target (the code's `min_team_hits = 3`). This shows you are managing your team's accountability well. If fewer than 3 reps reach their target, you earn no monthly bonus that month, regardless of how any single rep performed. This is not a punishment. It is an honest reflection of your team's result for that month. Your annual bonus is calculated separately from your accountability score bars. 📊 Accountability Score (Bars) for Sales Managers As a Sales Manager, you earn bars based on your team's performance. 3 sold new packages above monthly targets equal 1 bar. Your monthly bonus is calculated at each extra new package above the monthly target. The bars measure who is rated number 1, then 2, and so on based on the number of bars accumulated that month. 📊 How Bars Work for Sales Managers Bars earned each month reset on the 29th. The total bars earned that month are added to your cumulative annual total. Your annual total determines how much annual bonus will be paid. The management sets the price each bar will be paid at based on the annual profitability gained that year. Until the bar value is set, bars show as numbers only. Tiered Bonus Payouts (per extra sale above the 5-sale minimum) Package Type Bonus Per Extra Sale Example: 10 extra sales Silver Package R50.00 R500 Gold Package R90.00 R900 Platinum Package R150.00 R1,500 Bonuses are paid monthly after the customer's first payment clears successfully. 🔄 The 3-Strike Principle At Zibuke OnCall, we measure accountability by what people do, not what they say. If a manager repeatedly fails to achieve the 3-of-team standard, it shows they are no longer managing their team's accountability effectively. This is not about punishment. It is about honest evaluation. How It Works One miss: If you fail to hit the 3-of-team target in a single month, that counts as one strike. Six misses in 12 months: If this happens 6 times within a rolling 12-month period, you are demoted to a Sales Representative position. You sell directly to customers. Your accountability shifts from managing others to demonstrating your own individual performance. Salary upon demotion: Your salary changes to the standard Sales Representative basic salary of R7,500.00 per month. You lose the Manager's tiered bonuses and earn Rep-level bonuses instead. No assigned team: As a demoted manager, you do not keep a team. You report to a Sales Manager like any other rep. You can earn your way back to Manager by consistently demonstrating accountability over time. 🛡️ The Newbie Buffer: A Fairness Clause We know that new Sales Representatives sometimes leave early. You should not be penalised for turnover you could not prevent. What counts as a Newbie: A Sales Representative in their first 3 months of employment, which is their Accountability Assessment phase. How the buffer works: If your team has 2 or more Newbies at any point during a calendar month, the strike rule is paused for that month. Any failure to hit the 3-of-team target during a month with 2 or more Newbies does not count as a strike against you. Once a Rep finishes their 3-month assessment, or your team drops to 1 or 0 Newbies, the 3-strike rule resumes. This gives you a protected window to train new staff without being penalised for their early-stage performance. 🎯 Your Role: Managing Your Team's Accountability You passed the Accountability Assessment. You proved your own accountability. Now, as a Sales Manager, your focus shifts to managing the accountability of others. Your Sales Representatives and interns look to you as the example of what our culture looks like in practice. Here is what you do: Coach your reps: Ride along with struggling Sales Representatives to help them close deals. Show them what accountability looks like when you are in the field with them. Keep your team active: Make sure all 12 reps are prospecting and logging customer registrations every day. Train new team members: Guide Newbies through their 45-package Accountability Assessment so they pass within their 3-month window. Supervise your interns: Help 1 to 3 interns complete their logbook workplace experience. Interns do not carry performance targets. Your job is to teach them what accountability looks like through your example. Protect quality standards: Make sure reps register serial numbers, check appliance ages, and only sign domestic use customers. Accountability means doing the right thing, every time. Track your team's results: Monitor outcomes so your team demonstrates accountability together, not just as individuals. 🧠 Accountability Runs Through Everything We Do Accountability is the foundation of Zibuke OnCall. It applies at every level. Sales Representatives show accountability by meeting their monthly benchmark. Sales Managers show accountability by ensuring at least 3 of their reps meet theirs. Supervisors who manage technicians show it through their team's quality of work. Logistics managers who manage drivers show it through reliable delivery. Every person at Zibuke OnCall lives by the same standard. As a Sales Manager, you own your team's accountability. You lead through coaching, example, and consistent standards, not through fear. 🎯 Who You Are You understand that the Sales Manager Accountability Assessment is a leadership test. You are ready to build a local team of Sales Representative candidates, to submit your certified ID and certified proof of bank account, and to manage up to fifty representatives until 12 of them graduate through their own 45-package assessment. You are not looking for a shortcut. You want to lead real people through a real path. You have experience in sales, customer service, leadership, coaching, or community work that will help you manage a team of up to fifty representatives and lead a core team of 12 reps. This can be formal employment, informal leadership, or community organising. We want a real answer, not a polished one. You are fluent in English and at least one other South African language. You are based in South Africa and available for occasional in-person team meetups. You understand that your salary depends on your team's performance, and you are ready to own that responsibility. 🔁 Already a Zibuke OnCall Sales Representative? If you are a current Zibuke OnCall Sales Representative who has sold above 5 packages per month for 5 consecutive months, you do not need to submit this form. Our system tracks your monthly performance automatically and flags you in the portal as eligible for promotion. Leadership confirms the promotion and you move from Sales Representative to Sales Manager directly, and you begin the 12-Rep Leadership Assessment rather than selling the 45 packages a second time. This form is for external candidates joining Zibuke OnCall for the first time. 📋 General Employment Terms Working Hours: Wednesday to Sunday, 9 hours per day. Monday and Tuesday are your days off. Code of Conduct: Act with integrity. Falsifying sales records or helping commit subscription fraud, such as hiding appliance ages or registering commercial businesses as domestic, results in immediate dismissal. Our Accountability Culture: Accountability is the foundation of Zibuke OnCall and every team within it. Working here means living by this culture every day. Accountability is not something we talk about. It is something we show through our actions, our coaching, and our results. Notice Period: 30 days written notice by either party. Resignation forfeits unpaid performance bonuses. Reassignment to Sales Representative comes with a new agreement at R7,500 per month. When Accountability Falls Short: We always follow labour regulations. The 20-package monthly benchmark exists so every team member can continuously demonstrate their accountability. If, after coaching and support, accountability is not being shown, employment may end. This always happens in accordance with labour law and with dignity. In rare cases where underperformance is due to factors beyond a person's control, we may consider transfer to another unit or division on a case by case basis. 📊 EXAMPLE MONTHLY EARNINGS Scenario Basic Salary Bonus Total 7 reps hit target, 5 do not, no extra sales R16,000 R0 R16,000 7 reps hit target, team sells 15 extra packages (mixed types) R16,000 ~R1,500 ~R17,500 All 12 reps hit target, team sells 30 extra packages R16,000 ~R3,000 ~R19,000 All 12 reps exceed targets, 50 or more extra Platinum heavy sales R16,000 R5,000+ R21,000+ 7 reps hit target and interns generate 20 extra sales R16,000 ~R1,500 (core) + ~R900 (intern) = ~R2,400 ~R18,400 All 12 reps hit target and interns generate 40 extra sales R16,000 ~R3,000 (core) + ~R1,800 (intern) = ~R4,800 ~R20,800 Note: Intern bonuses only apply when at least 3 core Sales Representatives reach their monthly target. If fewer than 3 reach their target, the intern bonus does not apply. ⚠️ This role comes with real accountability. Your R16,000 salary is funded by your team's portfolio performance. If you fail to get 3 of your reps to reach their targets 6 times in a rolling 12-month period, you are demoted to a Sales Representative at R7,500 per month. You also lose your intern bonus if your core team does not perform. You need to be ready for this responsibility before you apply. 🧭 Choosing How Your Team Sells As a Sales Manager, you choose one of three sales approaches and train your whole team on it. Door to door sales campaigns. Online community building. Or your own custom sales training, built and proved through your portal. You choose one of the three and commit every representative on your team to it. Door to door sales campaigns are much faster. You train your team using the door to door training already on the Sales Representative candidate portal. They close sales quickly because you are standing in the home where the appliances live, and they require you to join your team on sales calls in the field, in person, side by side with your representatives. Online community building is slower and simpler. You build a community of appliance owners online, qualify them, and approach them one by one. It allows truly remote sales management, where you lead your team without being in the field. Your own custom sales training lets you write, submit, and prove a method you have developed yourself, and then train your team on it once it produces results. Whichever approach you choose, your representatives send their end of day notes and feedback to the corporate email we issued you as a Sales Manager candidate and through the in-app messenger. You read those notes every working day and you respond, because that is how you carry your team forward. Choose the approach that fits how you lead. If you can be in the field with your team, door to door will get them to 45 fastest. If you must lead remotely, online community building is the simpler path. Pick one of the three and commit your whole team to it. Apply for the Sales Manager Accountability Assessment This is where you start at Zibuke OnCall. Submit your application and leadership will review your background. Once approved, you are registered as a Sales Manager candidate. Before you begin, you submit your certified ID and certified proof of bank account, and we issue your Zibuke OnCall email and your tailored advert. You then build and lead a local team of Sales Representative candidates until 12 of them graduate through their own 45-package assessment. When 12 have graduated, you are confirmed as a permanent Sales Manager and you earn a R16,000 monthly basic salary, a monthly bonus when 3 of your representatives reach their monthly target, and an annual bonus from your accountability score bars. 📌 The Sales Manager Assessment is a leadership test. You no longer sell 45 packages yourself. You submit your certified ID and certified proof of bank account, receive your Zibuke OnCall email, register an employer account on Indeed or SA Youth using our CIPC registration number, the Zibuke Africa company name, and our sector, and post one advert based on the town or township where you live. You then manage your local representatives, earn commission on every repair plan they sell (8% Silver / 10% Gold / 12% Platinum of the net subscription value), and pass only when 12 of them graduate through their own 45-package assessment. If another candidate already covers your area, the existing account holder places a new advert for you. For guidance at any point, email [email protected] and we will respond and assist you. If you would prefer to join an existing team as a Sales Representative , that role becomes available once a manager is confirmed. View the Sales Representative page for context. ✅ APPLICATION SUBMITTED Hi , Thank you for applying to Zibuke OnCall . We have received your application and the management will review it within 5 business days. Application reference: Position applied for: You can track your application status at any time using your reference number. Track your application at: zibukeoncall.co.za/track-application.html The Zibuke OnCall team Queries: [email�protected] | Office Hours: Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM SAST ← Back to Careers Hub

documents.title: Sales Representative | Zibuke OnCall Careers
documents.text: Sales Representative | Zibuke OnCall Careers Now Hiring Sales Representative You help families manage their home maintenance by explaining repair plans honestly. You sell with clarity, not pressure. You build trust in your community one conversation at a time. Apply Now R7 500 Monthly Salary (Phase 2) 45 Packages to Graduate 20 Monthly Target R16 000 Sales Manager Salary ✅ This role is live. Apply now to begin your Accountability Assessment. Why the Sales Representative Role Exists Zibuke OnCall sells repair plans that help customers manage their home maintenance. A Sales Representative does not just sell a plan. The Sales Representative explains the service, answers customer questions honestly, records appliance details correctly, and helps customers make a clear decision. This role matters because every honest sale builds trust between Zibuke OnCall and the community. When a customer signs up for a repair plan, they are trusting us with their money and their appliances. If the sale is honest, the customer feels safe. If the sale is pressured, the customer feels cheated. You will be the person families trust to manage their home maintenance. You will explain what is included in their plan and what is not. You will tell them about the 6-month waiting period. You will record the make, model, and serial number of every appliance correctly. You will help them make a decision they can live with. This is not about closing deals. This is about building relationships. Every customer you sign up honestly is a customer who trusts Zibuke OnCall. Every customer you pressure is a customer who might cancel or complain. You make the difference. What You Will Do Every day, you will explain, record, and build trust. Your work helps families manage their home maintenance and helps Zibuke OnCall grow honestly. Explain Zibuke OnCall repair plans honestly. Tell customers about coverage, waiting periods, and terms in clear language. Record the make, model, and serial number of every appliance correctly. Build trust in your community. Represent Zibuke OnCall professionally. Follow the accountability assessment process. Keep customer records accurate. Report work honestly. Treat every customer with respect. Help customers make informed decisions without pressure or confusion. Who Should Apply This role is for someone who believes in honest selling. You do not pressure people. You explain clearly. You let the customer decide. You understand that trust is more valuable than a quick sale. You should apply if: You can explain complex things in simple language. You are honest about what a product can and cannot do. You record details correctly because you know small mistakes can cause big problems. You treat every customer with respect, even when they say no. You can handle rejection without taking it personally. You want to build a career based on accountability and trust. You are willing to prove yourself through real results, not interviews. We do not require specific qualifications for this role. We require proof that you can sell honestly and build trust. You will complete an accountability assessment before appointment. This assessment proves you can do the work. Phase 1: Accountability Assessment Before you earn a guaranteed salary, you prove yourself through real work. This is Phase 1. It is commission only. You earn money from every sale you make, but you do not receive a basic salary yet. How Phase 1 Works Phase 1 lasts a maximum of 3 months. Your target is to sell 45 active, paying subscriptions. You graduate when your 45th active customer pays their first subscription. When you graduate, you move to Phase 2 the following month. Milestone Check at Month 3 If you have not reached 45 packages by the end of Month 3, you need at least 33 packages to qualify for a one month extension. If you have 33 or more, you may receive one more month to reach 45. If you have fewer than 33, your assessment ends at the 3 month mark. Commission During Phase 1 You earn commission on every active, paying subscription. The commission is calculated on the net subscription price after 15% VAT is removed. Commission Structure 1 Silver Package: You earn 8% of the net price after 15% VAT is removed. 2 Gold Package: You earn 10% of the net price after 15% VAT is removed. 3 Platinum Package: You earn 12% of the net price after 15% VAT is removed. The commission level depends on the package the customer chooses. You earn commission from the first sale. There is no minimum number of sales before commission starts. Graduation Into Phase 2 You move from Phase 1 to Phase 2 when you sell 45 active, paying subscriptions. This means 45 customers have signed up and paid their first subscription. When you graduate, you start earning a guaranteed basic salary the following month. You also become eligible for monthly bonuses on top of your salary. Phase 1 is performance based. Phase 2 is salary based with performance bonuses. The difference is clear: in Phase 1, you earn only what you sell. In Phase 2, you earn a guaranteed salary plus bonuses for selling above your target. Phase 2: Salary and Bonus Basic Salary After you graduate from Phase 1, you earn a guaranteed basic salary of R7 500 per month . This is paid every month regardless of your sales performance. It is your guaranteed income. Monthly Target Your monthly target is 20 new packages. This is the number of new sales you need to make each month to demonstrate accountability. The first 20 packages are part of your monthly target and do not create bonus packages. Monthly Bonus You qualify for a bonus when you sell more than 20 new packages in a month. The bonus is calculated on the net subscription price after 15% VAT is removed, multiplied by the number of new packages above 20. Bonus Formula 1 Count the number of new packages you sold in the month. 2 Subtract 20 from that number. This is your bonus package count. 3 Multiply the bonus package count by the net subscription price after 15% VAT is removed. 4 Formula: (Subscription Price minus 15% VAT) multiplied by (New Packages minus 20). How Bonuses Work Customer Payment Type Your Bonus Example: Gold Package Monthly Customer 100% of First Month's Net Premium R399 minus 15% VAT = R347 net. You get R347 bonus Annual Upfront 10% of Net Annual Upfront R3,990 minus 15% VAT = R3,470 net. You get R347 bonus We pay your bonuses in the same month the sale is verified and your customer's first payment clears. Earnings Examples These examples show what you could earn each month in Phase 2. Actual earnings depend on the subscription price, VAT, and the number of packages sold above the target. Packages Sold Bonus Calculation Basic Salary Total 5 R0 (first 5 included in salary) R7 500 R7 500 8 (3 extra) 3 multiplied by ~R347 (Gold average) = R1 041 R7 500 R8 541 12 (7 extra) 7 multiplied by ~R347 = R2 429 R7 500 R9 929 20 (15 extra) 15 multiplied by ~R347 = R5 205 R7 500 R12 705 If you sell more than 20 packages, every package above 20 counts for bonus and accountability bar score. An annual upfront customer earns you the same bonus from a single sale. Working Hours The Sales Representative works from Wednesday to Sunday. The workday is 9 hours per day. Monday and Tuesday are days off. This schedule gives you two consecutive days to rest and recharge. It also means you work when customers are home and available to talk about their appliance protection needs. Promotion Path A Sales Representative can progress toward Sales Manager. Promotion is earned through accountable performance, not promised in advance. Eligibility for Promotion You must meet the 20 package monthly minimum consistently. You must miss the 20 package minimum no more than 3 times in a rolling 12 month period. You must have passed the 45 package Accountability Assessment yourself. If you miss the 20 package minimum 4 or more times in a year, you must wait until the oldest miss drops off your 12 month record before you can be promoted. Sales Manager Role The next role is Sales Manager. The Sales Manager basic salary is R16 000 per month. The Sales Manager leads a core team of 12 Sales Representatives and earns bonuses when their team performs well. Promotion is not automatic. It is based on consistent, accountable performance over time. Accountability Bar Score After passing your assessment, you earn an Accountability Score measured in bars. Bars measure your ranking among colleagues. How Accountability Bars Are Earned 1 You earn 1 accountability bar for each package sold above your monthly target . 2 Formula: New Packages Sold minus Monthly Target = Accountability Bars. Accountability Bar Examples Example 1: If you sell 25 packages and your target is 20, you earn 5 accountability bars. Example 2: If you sell 30 packages and your target is 20, you earn 10 accountability bars. Example 3: If you sell 20 packages or fewer, you earn 0 accountability bars. Annual Bonus Bars earned each month reset on the 29th, but are added to your cumulative annual total which determines your annual bonus. The management sets the value of each bar based on annual profitability. Job Security The Sales Representative role is secure for people who do the work well. Here is what you need to know about keeping your job. Portfolio Requirement Your job stays secure while you keep a portfolio above 45 active customers. This means you have at least 45 customers who are paying their subscriptions. If your portfolio drops below 45, you need to build it back up. Monthly Target You need to sell at least 20 new packages every month to demonstrate accountability. This is your performance baseline. If you consistently fall below this target, even after management has offered support and interventions, your employment may end in accordance with labour law. Transfer Consideration If you are underperforming because of factors outside your control, we may consider moving you to another unit or division within Zibuke OnCall. We evaluate these situations on a case by case basis. We follow labour regulations at all times. The 20 package monthly target exists so you can show us, every month, that your accountability is strong. If you fall short after support has been offered, your employment may end. This always happens with dignity and within the law. Ready to Start? If you believe in honest selling. If you want to help families manage their home maintenance. If you are willing to prove yourself through real work. Apply now. Apply Now Frequently Asked Questions Is the Sales Representative role open now? The role is live. Apply now to begin your Accountability Assessment. What is Phase 1? Phase 1 is the Accountability Assessment. It is commission only. You have a maximum of 3 months to sell 45 active, paying subscriptions. You earn commission on every sale, but you do not receive a basic salary yet. You graduate when your 45th active customer pays their first subscription. What happens if I do not reach 45 packages in 3 months? If you have at least 33 packages by the end of Month 3, you may receive a one month extension. If you have fewer than 33, your assessment ends at the 3 month mark. How much commission do I earn in Phase 1? Silver Package: 8% of the net price after 15% VAT is removed. Gold Package: 10% of the net price. Platinum Package: 12% of the net price. You earn commission from the first sale. What is Phase 2? Phase 2 begins after you sell 45 active, paying subscriptions. You earn a guaranteed basic salary of R7 500 per month. You also qualify for bonuses when you sell more than 20 new packages in a month. How is the bonus calculated? The bonus is calculated on the net subscription price after 15% VAT is removed, multiplied by the number of new packages above 20. For example, if you sell 8 packages, 3 are bonus packages. At ~R347 per Gold package, the bonus is about R1 041. What are accountability bars? You earn 1 accountability bar for each package sold above your monthly target. For example, if you sell 25 packages and your target is 20, you earn 5 bars. Bars accumulate annually and determine your annual bonus. What are the working hours? Wednesday to Sunday, 9 hours per day. Monday and Tuesday are days off. Can I be promoted? Yes. You can progress toward Sales Manager. You must miss the 20 package minimum no more than 3 times in a rolling 12 month period. The Sales Manager basic salary is R16 000 per month. Promotion is earned through consistent, accountable performance. What happens if I consistently miss the target? If you consistently fail to meet the 20 package monthly target, even after management has offered support and interventions, your employment may end in accordance with labour law. We follow labour regulations at all times. Apply for Sales Representative Complete the form below to apply. All fields are required. Your application will be reviewed by the Zibuke OnCall team. APPLICATION SUBMITTED Thank you for applying. The Zibuke OnCall team will review your application. Your reference is . You can track your application at any time using your reference number. Track your application at: zibukeoncall.co.za/track-application

documents.title: Technician Assessment | Zibuke OnCall Careers
documents.text: Technician Assessment | Zibuke OnCall Careers 📞 Enquiries: +27 18 007 0525 📍 Contact Us 📋 Package Plans TECHNICAL DEPARTMENT TECHNICIAN ASSESSMENT You prove your skill through real repairs, not interviews. Complete 48 jobs without any callback and your permanent position as a Technician at Zibuke OnCall is yours. Apply Now ↓ 📌 Zibuke OnCall Accountability: The Operations department assessment requires completing 48 repairs without any callback within 2 months . If you have completed 28 repairs without callbacks by the end of the second month, you will be given a conditional one-month extension. This page explains how the assessment works and what you can expect. ⏰ Your Working Hours Wednesday to Sunday • 9 hours per day • Monday & Tuesday off Why We Do Not Use Interviews You deserve to be judged by what you can do, not by how well you talk about yourself in a room. A 30-minute conversation does not tell us whether you can fix a washing machine or earn a family's trust in their home. We have seen too many people interview brilliantly and then struggle in the actual role because interviews test one skill: interviewing. At Zibuke OnCall, you show us who you are by doing the work. We give you real appliances, real customers, and real responsibility. What you do with that opportunity tells us everything we need to know about your skill, your reliability, and your character. We trust what you demonstrate, not what you rehearse. The Benchmark: 48 Repairs Without Callback To earn your permanent position as a Technician, you complete 48 appliance repairs without any callback within 2 months. This is not a number we picked at random. Forty-eight repairs give us an honest picture of who you really are. You prove five things: Technical Skill: You can diagnose and fix real appliances, from washing machines and fridges to ovens and televisions. Reliability: You keep your word. When you say you will show up, you show up. When you start a job, you finish it properly. Care: You treat every customer's appliance as if it belongs to someone you love. Quality workmanship every single time. Accountability: You own your repairs. No shortcuts, no cutting corners, no excuses. You stand behind what you fix. Generosity: You approach every job wanting to genuinely help a family get back to normal. Generosity is something you demonstrate through action, and that is exactly what we look for. No interview in the world can reveal these five qualities. Only your work can. That is why the Accountability Assessment exists. When you prove yourself through action, we trust you. And that trust is the foundation of everything at Zibuke OnCall. How the Assessment Works 1 You Apply Below You submit your application here. Our team reads every single one. We look for relevant technical experience with appliance repairs, South African residency, and a genuine desire to repair appliances for families. You do not need formal qualifications. What matters is that you already know how to repair appliances. We will test what you can do at our workshop, not in an interview room. 2 You Report to a Workshop Our workshops are spread throughout South Africa. When you are accepted, you will be assigned to the workshop closest to you. In some cases technicians may need to relocate to be at the closest workshop. You report to your workshop where you find tools, parts, and appliances that need repairs. Our Technical Supervisor guides the process and confirms every repair you complete. This is not a training program. You come to us already able to repair appliances. What you find at the workshop are the tools to do your job, the parts you need, and the appliances that need fixing. You are here to prove that you know your work and that you can do it to our standard. You earn a commission on every repair you complete. There is no basic salary during this phase because your earnings reflect what you actually deliver. This is how you and Zibuke OnCall both know your results are real. 3 You Complete 48 Repairs Without Callback Your goal is 48 completed repairs without any callback within 2 months . Every repair is logged and confirmed by the customer as working. You have full access to parts, tools, and mentorship from our experienced technicians. We give you everything you need to succeed. 📌 28-Repair Milestone: To qualify for a possible extension, you must have completed at least 28 repairs without callbacks by the end of your second month. If you reach 28, you may be granted a single one-month extension at your manager's discretion to complete the remaining 20. If you are below 28 at the end of month 2, no extension is possible. 4 You Earn Your Permanent Position The moment you complete your 48th repair without callback, you are a permanent Technician at Zibuke OnCall. You move to a full salary with benefits. Those 48 repairs are your proof to us and to yourself that you belong here. If You Do Not Reach 48 If you do not reach 48 repairs without callbacks within the 2-month assessment period, you will not pass. If you reached 28 repairs by the end of month 2, you will receive a one-month extension. If you still do not reach 48 by the end of the extension, you do not pass. But you keep every rand of commission you earned. You walk away with real experience, real earnings, and real proof of what you can do. That is more than any traditional interview rejection could ever give you. Your Compensation as a Technician Your pay is designed to reward the quality and volume of your work at every stage of your career with us. During the Accountability Assessment: You earn commission of R50 to R120 per repaired appliance based on the type of appliance. Simple repairs earn R50. Complex repairs on items like televisions, ovens, and home theatre equipment earn up to R120. The commission is paid on every repair you complete, whether you pass the assessment or not. After You Pass the Assessment: You move to a basic salary of R10,000 per month . Your commission earnings stop and your salary begins. You now qualify for monthly and annual bonuses on top of your salary. Monthly Performance Bonus: Every month you repair more than 35 appliances, you earn a monthly bonus. The bonus amount is calculated based on the volume and the types of appliances repaired in your workshop that month. The more you do, and the more complex the repairs, the higher your bonus. Annual Performance Bonus: On top of your monthly bonus, you earn an annual performance bonus based on your accountability bar score. Your bar score is calculated by the end of January each year. The higher your score, the larger your annual bonus. Summary: R10,000 monthly salary after you pass, plus commission during assessment, plus monthly bonuses for repairs above 35, plus annual bonuses based on your accountability score. Your earnings grow as you prove yourself. Start Your Technician Assessment When you submit this form, you are registering to begin the Accountability Assessment for the Technician position. You are not an employee yet. You become a permanent Technician when you complete 48 repairs without any callback within 2 months. Fill in your details below to get started. ✅ APPLICATION SUBMITTED Hi , Thank you for applying to Zibuke OnCall . We have received your application and the management will review it within 5 business days. Application reference: Position applied for: You can track your application status at any time using your reference number. Track your application at: zibukeoncall.co.za/track-application.html The Zibuke OnCall team Queries: [email�protected] | Office Hours: Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM SAST ← Back to Jobs

documents.title: Technical Manager Assessment | Zibuke OnCall Careers
documents.text: Technical Manager Assessment | Zibuke OnCall Careers 📞 Enquiries: +27 18 007 0525 📍 Contact Us 📋 Package Plans OPERATIONS DEPARTMENT TECHNICAL MANAGER You first prove yourself as a Technician by completing 48 repairs without callback at our workshop within 2 months. That is the same Accountability Assessment every technician passes. After you earn your permanent Technician position, you can advance to lead a team of up to 25 technicians as a Technical Manager. Note: the codebase defines no technical_manager salary default — `src/handlers/salary.js` has a fallback for `technician` (R10,000) but not for `technical_manager`, and the hire path (`careers.js`) only creates `sales_manager`, `sales_rep`, or `intern` employee roles. A Technical Manager position requires a configured salary rule and hire path. Apply Now ↓ 📌 Zibuke OnCall Accountability: The Technical Manager role is not an entry level position. You must first pass the Technician Accountability Assessment by completing 48 repairs without any callback within 2 months at our workshop. Once you are a permanent Technician, you can advance to Technical Manager where you manage up to 25 technicians at a workshop. Your earnings grow as your team performs. ⏰ Your Working Hours Wednesday to Sunday • 9 hours per day • Monday & Tuesday off Why the Technical Manager Role Exists Every workshop needs a leader who ensures quality. A Technical Manager is responsible for the repairs that leave your workshop, the technicians who perform them, and the trust that families place in Zibuke OnCall when they get their appliances back. You make sure every repair is done right and every technician on your team meets the standard that our customers deserve. You must first become a Technician at Zibuke OnCall. You start by completing the Technician Accountability Assessment. That means 48 repairs without any callback within 2 months at our workshop. You use our tools and parts. You prove you can fix appliances to our standard. Every technician who joins Zibuke OnCall passes this same assessment. Once you are a permanent Technician, you can advance to Technical Manager. You are based at a workshop. You manage up to 25 technicians. Your job is not to repair every appliance yourself. Your job is to ensure that every technician you manage repairs every appliance properly. You guide them, you check their work, and you take responsibility for the quality that leaves your workshop. Your Path and Compensation as a Technical Manager Your journey starts with the Technician Accountability Assessment. Every technical manager at Zibuke OnCall begins there. Your pay is designed to reward you at every stage. Step 1: Pass the Technician Accountability Assessment. You complete 48 repairs without any callback within 2 months at our workshop. There is no basic salary during the assessment (per the code, assessment is unpaid for basic salary). Step 2: You are hired as a permanent Technician. You move to a basic salary of R10,000 per month (the default fallback for the `technician` role in `src/handlers/salary.js`) plus annual bonuses based on your accountability bar score. Note: the code does not implement a "bonus for repairs above 35" — the only code bonus is the sales-rep package bonus in `handleProcessSalary`. Step 3: Technical Manager. The codebase has no `technical_manager` salary default and no hire path for it (`careers.js` only creates `sales_manager`, `sales_rep`, or `intern` employee roles). A Technical Manager position requires a configured salary rule and a hire path before it can be paid. Monthly Performance Bonus: Not implemented in the code. The code has no "15 technicians" monthly bonus for managers. Annual Performance Bonus: Annual bonuses are based on accountability bar score, set by the master. The code does not implement a "1 bar per 4 technicians" rule — `BAR_VALUES` only defines sale/repair/delivery/manager bonus bars. Summary: Start as a Technician candidate and pass the 48 repair assessment. Become a permanent Technician at R10,000 per month (code default). The R18,000 Technical Manager salary, the "15 technicians" monthly bonus, and the "1 bar per 4 technicians" rule are not implemented in the code — they require a configured salary rule and hire path first. What We Look For in a Technical Manager You start by passing the Technician Accountability Assessment. That means 48 repairs without any callback within 2 months at our workshop. This is the same assessment every technician at Zibuke OnCall passes. You prove that you can repair appliances to our standard using the tools and parts at our workshop. Once you are a permanent Technician, you can advance to Technical Manager. What we look for in someone who will succeed as a Technical Manager: Technical Knowledge: You understand appliance repair at a level that allows you to guide others. When a technician is stuck, you can diagnose the problem and show them the solution. Leadership: You can manage up to 25 people. You set clear expectations. You hold people accountable. You celebrate their wins and you address their failures directly. Quality Standards: You know what a proper repair looks like and you do not accept less. You check work before it leaves the workshop because you know every appliance going back to a family represents your name and the Zibuke OnCall name. Ownership: You take responsibility for your team's results. When they succeed, you credit them. When they fail, you own it and you fix it. Your Path to Becoming a Technical Manager 1 Pass the Technician Accountability Assessment You start by completing the same assessment every technician at Zibuke OnCall must pass. You complete 48 repairs without any callback within 2 months at our workshop. You use our tools and our parts. You prove that your skill is real and that you can repair appliances to our standard. Until you pass this assessment, you cannot become a Technical Manager. There is no shortcut. Every technical manager at Zibuke OnCall earned their place the same way. 2 You Become a Permanent Technician Once you complete 48 repairs without callback, you are a permanent Technician at Zibuke OnCall. You earn R10,000 per month (the default fallback for the `technician` role in `src/handlers/salary.js`). You now have a career here. You know the standard because you met it. 3 You Advance to Technical Manager From your position as a Technician, you can advance to Technical Manager. Note: the codebase has no `technical_manager` salary default — `src/handlers/salary.js` does not list this role, so the fallback pays R0 until the master configures a `base_salary` salary rule. The hire path (`careers.js`) also only creates `sales_manager`, `sales_rep`, or `intern` employee roles. You manage up to 25 technicians at our workshop. You are responsible for their quality, their development, and their results. You check every repair before it leaves your workshop. You ensure that families get their appliances back working perfectly. 4 You Earn Bonuses Through Your Team's Success Annual bonuses are based on your accountability bar score, which the master values each year. The "15 technicians" monthly bonus and the "1 bar per 4 technicians" rule are not implemented in the code — `BAR_VALUES` only defines sale/repair/delivery/manager-bonus bars. When your team succeeds, you succeed. Your Accountability Bar Score The code does not implement a technician-count bar rule (for example "1 bar per 4 technicians"). Accountability bars in the code are awarded for sales (`BAR_VALUES.sales_rep`), repairs (`BAR_VALUES.repair = 1`), deliveries (`BAR_VALUES.delivery = 1`), and manager monthly bonus (`manager_monthly`), each valued by the master at year end for the annual bonus. This system is designed to focus your leadership on what matters most: helping your team succeed. When your technicians achieve their bonuses, you achieve yours. When they grow, you grow. That is accountability at Zibuke OnCall. Start Your Journey to Technical Manager You start by applying for the Technician position and passing the Accountability Assessment. That means 48 repairs without any callback within 2 months at our workshop. Once you are a permanent Technician, you can advance to Technical Manager. If you already know you want that path, this form lets you register your interest. We will contact you when we review your application and guide you through the first step: the Technician Accountability Assessment. ✅ APPLICATION SUBMITTED Hi , Thank you for applying to Zibuke OnCall . We have received your application and the management will review it within 5 business days. Application reference: Position applied for: You can track your application status at any time using your reference number. Track your application at: zibukeoncall.co.za/track-application.html The Zibuke OnCall team Queries: [email�protected] | Office Hours: Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM SAST ← Back to Jobs

documents.title: Driver | Zibuke OnCall Careers
documents.text: Driver | Zibuke OnCall Careers Now Hiring Driver Collect broken appliances from customers. Deliver repaired appliances back on time. Carry every item with care. Keep the promise that makes customers trust Zibuke OnCall. Apply Now R7 500 Base Salary Per Month 70 Jobs Assessment Target Why the Driver Role Exists Zibuke OnCall collects broken appliances from customers. We repair them at our workshop. We deliver them back on time. This is the promise we make to every customer. The Driver protects that promise. Without careful collection, customers feel anxious about their belongings. Without on time delivery, customers lose trust. Without honest reporting, problems stay hidden. This role exists because every appliance belongs to someone's home. A washing machine is not just a machine. It is how a family keeps their clothes clean. A fridge is not just a fridge. It is how a family keeps their food fresh. When you carry an appliance with care, you carry a family's trust. You will collect broken appliances from customers. You will deliver repaired appliances back to customers. You will follow routes planned by the Distribution Manager. You will call customers when needed. You will handle every appliance as if it belongs to your own family. What You Will Do Every day, you will collect, deliver, and report. Your work keeps appliances moving and customers informed. Collect broken appliances from customers. Deliver repaired appliances back to customers. Follow the route planned by the Distribution Manager. Arrive on time for scheduled collections and deliveries. Call customers where required. Confirm addresses when needed. Handle appliances carefully. Carry heavy appliances safely. Work with your assistant when carrying large or heavy items. Protect customer property during collection and delivery. Update job status in real time. Upload proof of collection and delivery. Report delays honestly. Report failed visits clearly. Report customer unavailability. Report incorrect addresses. Report missing appliances or damaged items. Keep the vehicle and work area organised. Treat customers with respect. Pass the accountability assessment before appointment. Continue to live the accountability culture of Zibuke OnCall every day. Who Should Apply This role is for someone who takes responsibility seriously. You do not wait to be told what to do. You see a problem and you solve it. You understand that customers are waiting and that every delayed delivery affects a family. You should apply if: You are fit and strong. You can carry heavy appliances safely without breaking them. You are careful with customer property. You handle every appliance as if it belongs to your own family. You are honest about delays and mistakes. You report problems clearly instead of hiding them. You can follow a planned route. You arrive on time for scheduled collections and deliveries. You can use the distribution portal on a phone. You update job status in real time. You can call customers clearly and respectfully. You confirm addresses when needed. You can work with an assistant. You choose someone you trust and lead them well. You are willing to pass the accountability assessment. You accept measurement by clear performance rules. We do not require specific qualifications for this role. We require proof that you can do the work. You will complete an accountability assessment before appointment. This assessment proves you understand collection, delivery, customer service, and responsibility. Physical requirement: This job is physically demanding. You will carry heavy appliances including washing machines, fridges, stoves, and other household items. You must be fit and strong enough to carry these items safely without damaging them or injuring yourself. If you cannot carry heavy appliances safely, this role is not suitable for you. Your Assistant You may select any person you like to be your assistant. Note: the codebase does not implement an assistant salary or role — an assistant's pay must be set up by the master as a salary rule if this arrangement is used. Choose someone you trust. Choose someone who can work well with customers. Choose someone who is fit and strong because the work includes carrying heavy appliances. Choose someone who is reliable because customers depend on both of you to arrive on time and handle their belongings with care. Your assistant must be able to carry heavy appliances safely without breaking them. Your assistant must understand that customers trust Zibuke OnCall with valuable household appliances. If your assistant is careless, customers lose trust. If your assistant is reliable, customers feel cared for. The assistant will also be assessed for fitness, strength, reliability, and careful handling of appliances. The assistant must pass this assessment before starting work. Salary and Bonus Base Salary The Driver earns a base salary of R7 500 per month (the default fallback for the `driver` role in `src/handlers/salary.js`). This is paid regardless of performance. It is your guaranteed income. Accountability Bars Per Completed Delivery You earn 1 accountability bar for every completed delivery (`BAR_VALUES.delivery = 1` in `src/constants.js`, awarded by `src/handlers/driver-routes.js`). Bars accumulate and determine your ranking and annual bonus. How Bars Are Earned 1 Each completed delivery on the driver route earns 1 accountability bar. 2 Bars are awarded automatically when the delivery is marked complete. 3 Bars reset monthly on the 29th and accumulate toward your annual total. Note: the codebase does not implement a per-day bonus (e.g. R80 per counted day) or a 90-task bonus threshold. Driver earnings are the R7,500 base salary plus accountability bars for completed deliveries. Accountability Bar Score The Driver earns accountability bars for each completed delivery (`BAR_VALUES.delivery = 1`). How Accountability Bars Are Calculated 1 You earn 1 accountability bar for each completed delivery . 2 Formula: Completed deliveries in the month = bars earned. Accountability Bar Examples Example 1: 10 completed deliveries = 10 accountability bars . Example 2: 14 completed deliveries = 14 accountability bars . Example 3: 8 completed deliveries = 8 accountability bars . Example 4: No completed deliveries = 0 accountability bars . Annual Bonus The annual bonus is calculated by multiplying the set annual amount per accountability bar by the total number of accountability bars you earned in the year. The set annual amount is defined by Zibuke OnCall payroll settings. Your accountability bars accumulate throughout the year. The more deliveries you complete each month, the more bars you earn, and the larger your annual bonus. Assessment and Appointment Before you are appointed as a Driver, you must complete and pass the accountability assessment. This assessment requires you to complete 70 jobs (collections and deliveries on time) within the assessment period. This assessment protects customers, drivers, assistants, and the company. It proves that you can handle appliances with care. It proves that you can arrive on time. It proves that you can report honestly. It proves that you take responsibility seriously. If you have not passed the assessment, you are not eligible for appointment. This is not negotiable. Every Driver at Zibuke OnCall has passed the same assessment. The assessment is fair. It is clear. It measures real work. If you do the work, you pass. If you do not do the work, you do not pass. There is no interview that replaces this proof. Assessment Sections Punctuality. You arrive on time for scheduled collections and deliveries. Responsibility. You take ownership of your work and your results. Customer communication. You call customers clearly and respectfully. Route discipline. You follow the planned route and complete stops in order. Honesty. You report delays, problems, and mistakes clearly. Problem solving. You handle unexpected situations with care. Ability to follow instructions. You do what the Distribution Manager asks. Care when handling appliances. You carry items safely without damage. Reporting accuracy. You update job status correctly and upload proof. Professional conduct. You treat customers and their property with respect. Understanding of collection and delivery process. You know how the work flows. Ability to carry heavy appliances safely. You are fit and strong enough for the job. Ability to work with an assistant. You lead your assistant well. Ability to use the distribution portal. You update status and upload proof on your phone. The Distribution Portal You will use a distribution portal built for drivers, assistants, and Distribution Managers. The portal makes your work clearer, simpler, and more accountable. Driver Portal Features Today's route with ordered stops. Customer name, phone number, and address for each stop. Appliance type and whether it is a collection or delivery. Scheduled time window and current task status. Navigation button to guide you to the next stop. Call customer button to confirm addresses or arrival times. Upload proof button to record collection or delivery evidence. Report delay button to flag problems honestly. Notes field for additional information about each stop. Route progress percentage showing how much of the route you have completed. Assistant selection section to choose your assistant. Assistant contact details for communication. Daily on time tracker showing your punctuality for the day. Monthly delivery and collection count showing your total tasks completed. Monthly bonus tracker showing your eligibility for the daily bonus. Accountability bar score tracker showing your accumulated bars. Assessment status showing whether you have passed or are still in assessment. Assessment score showing your performance in the assessment. Pass or fail result showing whether you are eligible for appointment. Retake history if you need to redo the assessment. Manager Portal Features Your Distribution Manager will use a separate portal to support you: Driver route assignment to plan your daily routes. Driver progress tracking to monitor your work during the day. Driver on time tracking to measure your punctuality. Driver delivery and collection count to track your monthly tasks. Driver bonus calculation to determine your daily bonus eligibility. Driver accountability bar calculation to track your accumulated bars. Assistant assignment to manage your assistant's details. Assistant pay status to ensure your assistant is paid correctly. Customer call history to review your communication with customers. Proof of collection to verify your collection evidence. Proof of delivery to verify your delivery evidence. Delay reports to review any problems you reported. Failed visit reports to track unsuccessful stops. Route reports to review route efficiency and completion. Driver performance reports to measure your overall results. Why This Role Matters When a customer gives us their broken washing machine, they are trusting us with something important. Their family depends on that machine. They are paying money they worked hard for. They are expecting us to fix it and bring it back on time. The Driver is the person who keeps that promise. You collect the machine with care. You deliver it back on time. You call the customer before arriving. You handle the appliance as if it belongs to your own family. If you are late, the customer worries. If you are careless, the customer feels uncared for. If you are honest about a problem, the customer respects you. If you arrive on time and handle the appliance well, the customer trusts Zibuke OnCall. This is not just driving. This is trust. Every careful collection is a customer who feels safe. Every on time delivery is a customer who believes in the service. Every honest report is a problem that gets solved. You make the difference. Strength matters because appliances are heavy. Care matters because every appliance belongs to someone's home. Honesty matters because customers deserve to know what is happening. You carry more than machines. You carry trust. How Accountability Works at Zibuke OnCall Accountability at Zibuke OnCall is not punishment. It is clarity. It means every person knows what is expected. Every person has the tools to do the work. Every person is measured on results, not politics. Every person is treated fairly. When you follow a route, the portal records it. When you complete a stop, the portal tracks it. When you call a customer, the portal logs it. When you are late, the portal shows it. This is not about watching people. It is about making sure the work is done right. It is about giving you the information you need to do your job well. It is about making sure customers get what they were promised. If you perform well, you are rewarded. If you struggle, you are supported. If there is a problem, you are expected to solve it. If you need help, you are expected to ask for it. Accountability is the foundation of everything we do. It is why customers trust us. It is why employees stay. It is why the company grows. Ready to Join the Team? If you are fit and strong. If you care about customers. If you can handle appliances with care. If you want to be rewarded for real performance. Apply now. Apply Now Frequently Asked Questions What is the base salary? The base salary is R7 500 per month (the default fallback for the `driver` role in `src/handlers/salary.js`). This is paid every month regardless of performance. How do I earn accountability bars? You earn 1 accountability bar for each completed delivery (`BAR_VALUES.delivery = 1`). The codebase does not implement a per-day bonus or a 90-task bonus threshold. Is there a daily performance bonus? No. The codebase does not implement a per-day bonus (for example R80 per counted day) or a 90-task bonus threshold. Driver earnings are the R7,500 base salary plus 1 accountability bar per completed delivery. How is the assistant paid? The assistant arrangement is a page-level description; the codebase does not implement an assistant salary (there is no assistant payroll record or role in `src/`). If an assistant is employed, their pay must be set up as a salary rule by the master. What are accountability bar scores? You earn 1 accountability bar for each completed delivery. For example, if you complete 10 deliveries, you earn 10 accountability bars. These bars accumulate throughout the year and are used to calculate your annual bonus. How is the annual bonus calculated? The annual bonus is calculated by multiplying the set annual amount per accountability bar by the total number of accountability bar scores you earned in the year. The set annual amount is defined by Zibuke OnCall payroll settings. Do I need to be fit and strong? Yes. This job is physically demanding. You will carry heavy appliances including washing machines, fridges, stoves, and other household items. You must be fit and strong enough to carry these items safely without damaging them or injuring yourself. Your assistant must also be fit and strong. What is the accountability assessment? The accountability assessment requires you to complete 70 jobs (collections and deliveries on time) within the assessment period. This assessment proves you can handle appliances with care, arrive on time, report honestly, and take responsibility seriously. You must pass this assessment before you can be appointed as a Driver. What is the distribution portal? The distribution portal is a digital tool that helps you manage your daily work. It shows your route, customer details, task status, and progress. It has buttons for navigation, calling customers, uploading proof, and reporting delays. It also tracks your monthly tasks, bonus eligibility, accountability bar scores, and assessment status. What are my main duties? Your main duties are collecting broken appliances from customers, delivering repaired appliances back to customers, following planned routes, arriving on time, calling customers when needed, handling appliances carefully, updating job status in real time, uploading proof, reporting delays honestly, and working with your assistant. Apply for Driver Complete the form below to apply. All fields are required. Your application will be reviewed by the Zibuke OnCall team. APPLICATION SUBMITTED Thank you for applying. The Zibuke OnCall team will review your application. Your reference is . You can track your application at any time using your reference number.
