documents.text: Distribution Manager | Zibuke OnCall Careers Now Hiring Distribution Manager Plan routes. Lead drivers. Protect the promise we make to every customer who trusts us with their appliance. Apply Now R10 000 Base Salary Per Month Up to 30 Drivers to Manage 70 Jobs Assessment Target Why the Distribution Manager Role Exists Zibuke OnCall collects broken appliances from customers. We repair them at our workshop. We deliver them back on time. This is the promise we make to every customer. The Distribution Manager protects that promise. Without good route planning, customers wait too long. Without good driver leadership, appliances are damaged or lost. Without accountability, the service falls apart. This role exists because distribution is not just moving boxes. It is the last impression a customer has of Zibuke OnCall. If the delivery is late, the customer loses trust. If the collection is careless, the customer feels uncared for. The Distribution Manager makes sure none of that happens. You will manage up to 30 drivers. You will plan their routes. You will track their progress. You will support them when things go wrong. You will hold them accountable when they do not do the work. And you will be held to the same standard. What You Will Do Every day, you will plan, monitor, and support the distribution team. Your work keeps appliances moving and customers informed. Plan collection and delivery routes for up to 30 drivers. Assign drivers to routes based on location, workload, timing, and service needs. Make sure appliances are collected from customers efficiently. Make sure repaired appliances are delivered back to customers on time. Work directly with drivers to improve route efficiency. Monitor driver progress during the day. Track completed jobs, pending jobs, delayed jobs, failed visits, and unresolved exceptions. Make sure drivers call customers where required. Support drivers when a customer is unavailable, an address is incorrect, or a route is delayed. Use the distribution portal to manage routes, tasks, calls, proof, reports, and performance. Review driver performance and coach drivers who need support. Keep accurate records of route plans, customer calls, delays, collections, and deliveries. Report serious delays or repeated failures to operations leadership. Protect the customer experience by making sure the distribution team acts with responsibility and care. Who Should Apply This role is for someone who takes responsibility seriously. You do not wait to be told what to do. You see a problem and you solve it. You understand that customers are waiting and that every delayed delivery affects a family. You should apply if: You have experience planning routes, managing drivers, or coordinating deliveries. You can manage multiple tasks at the same time without losing focus. You communicate clearly with drivers, customers, and managers. You use technology to track work and keep records accurate. You hold yourself and others accountable for results. You stay calm when a route is delayed or a customer is difficult. You care about doing the job right, not just doing the job fast. We do not require specific qualifications for this role. We require proof that you can do the work. You will complete an accountability assessment before appointment. This assessment proves you understand distribution, customer service, and responsibility. Salary and Bonus Base Salary The Distribution Manager earns a base salary of R10 000 per month (the default fallback for the `logistics_manager` role in `src/handlers/salary.js`). This is paid every month regardless of team performance. It is your guaranteed income. Note: the codebase does not implement a driver-count monthly bonus (for example R120 per qualifying driver above a threshold). Driver earnings are the R7,500 base salary plus 1 accountability bar per completed delivery (`BAR_VALUES.delivery = 1`). If a Distribution Manager bonus is intended, the master must configure it as a salary rule. Accountability Bar Score Accountability bars in the code are awarded per completed delivery (`BAR_VALUES.delivery = 1` in `src/constants.js`, awarded by `src/handlers/driver-routes.js`). The code does not implement a "qualifying driver ÷ 3" bar rule for distribution managers. Annual Bonus The annual bonus is calculated by multiplying the set annual amount per accountability bar by the total number of accountability bars you earned in the year. The set annual amount is defined by Zibuke OnCall payroll settings. Your accountability bars accumulate throughout the year. The more deliveries your drivers complete, the more bars are earned, and the larger your annual bonus. Assessment and Appointment Before you are appointed as a Distribution Manager, you must complete and pass the same accountability assessment used for drivers. This assessment requires you to complete 70 jobs (collections and deliveries on time) within the assessment period. This assessment protects customers, drivers, and the company. It proves that you understand the work your drivers do. It proves that you can plan routes that work. It proves that you take responsibility seriously. If you have not passed the assessment, you are not eligible for appointment. This is not negotiable. Every Distribution Manager at Zibuke OnCall has passed the same assessment as every driver. The assessment is fair. It is clear. It measures real work. If you do the work, you pass. If you do not do the work, you do not pass. There is no interview that replaces this proof. The Distribution Portal You will use a distribution portal built for managers and drivers. The portal makes your work clearer, simpler, and more accountable. Manager Portal Features A dashboard showing today's collections, deliveries, completed tasks, pending tasks, delayed tasks, and failed visits. A dashboard showing drivers on route, drivers not started, on time percentage, and average route completion time. A dashboard showing customer calls made, customers not reachable, and reschedules. A route planning screen for creating and managing routes. A driver assignment screen for assigning drivers to routes. A customer call history screen for tracking all calls. A task status screen for monitoring collection and delivery progress. A proof of collection and delivery screen for viewing driver uploads. A performance report screen for reviewing driver and team results. A driver assessment screen for tracking assessment progress. A manager assessment screen for your own assessment status. A route efficiency report for optimising travel time. Daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports. Driver Portal Features Your drivers will use a mobile-friendly portal that shows: Today's route with ordered stops. Customer name, phone number, and address for each stop. Appliance type and whether it is a collection or delivery. Scheduled time window and current task status. Navigation button, call customer button, and upload proof button. Report delay button and notes field. Route progress percentage. Why This Role Matters When a customer gives us their broken washing machine, they are trusting us with something important. Their family depends on that machine. They are paying money they worked hard for. They are expecting us to fix it and bring it back on time. The Distribution Manager is the person who makes sure that promise is kept. You plan the route that gets the driver to the customer on time. You make sure the driver calls the customer before arriving. You track the delivery so it does not get lost in the system. If a driver is late, you know about it. If a customer is not answering, you make sure someone follows up. If an address is wrong, you help the driver find the right one. If a route is too long, you plan a better one. This is not just logistics. This is trust. Every on time delivery is a customer who believes in Zibuke OnCall. Every late delivery is a customer who might not come back. You make the difference. Drivers need leadership. They need someone who plans routes that work. They need someone who supports them when a customer is difficult. They need someone who holds them accountable when they do not do the work. You are that person. How Accountability Works at Zibuke OnCall Accountability at Zibuke OnCall is not punishment. It is clarity. It means every person knows what is expected. Every person has the tools to do the work. Every person is measured on results, not politics. Every person is treated fairly. When you plan a route, the portal records it. When a driver completes a stop, the portal tracks it. When a customer is called, the portal logs it. When a delivery is late, the portal shows it. This is not about watching people. It is about making sure the work is done right. It is about giving you the information you need to lead your team. It is about making sure customers get what they were promised. If your drivers perform well, you are rewarded. If your drivers struggle, you are supported. If there is a problem, you are expected to solve it. If you need help, you are expected to ask for it. Accountability is the foundation of everything we do. It is why customers trust us. It is why employees stay. It is why the company grows. Driver Accountability Every driver you manage must follow the same accountability standards. This is how the distribution team stays strong. Each driver must be assigned to one Distribution Manager. Each driver must pass the accountability assessment before appointment. Each driver must follow the route planned by the manager. Each driver must call customers where required. Each driver must update job status in real time. Each driver must complete collection and delivery tasks on time. Each driver must report delays, failed visits, customer unavailability, incorrect addresses, missing appliances, and other exceptions. As the Distribution Manager, you are responsible for making sure your drivers meet these standards. You support them when they struggle. You hold them accountable when they do not do the work. Ready to Lead the Distribution Team? If you take responsibility seriously. If you care about customers. If you can lead drivers and plan routes that work. If you want to be rewarded for real performance. Apply now. Apply Now Frequently Asked Questions What is the base salary? The base salary is R10 000 per month (the default fallback for the `logistics_manager` role in `src/handlers/salary.js`). This is paid every month regardless of team performance. How does the monthly performance bonus work? The codebase does not implement a driver-count monthly bonus (for example R120 per qualifying driver above an 18-driver threshold). If a Distribution Manager bonus is intended, the master must configure it as a salary rule in the Employee Portal. What if fewer than 18 drivers qualify? There is no driver-count bonus threshold in the code. Driver earnings are the R7,500 base salary plus 1 accountability bar per completed delivery (`BAR_VALUES.delivery = 1`). How many drivers will I manage? You will manage up to 30 drivers. The exact number depends on operational needs. What is the accountability assessment? The accountability assessment requires you to complete 70 jobs (collections and deliveries on time) within the assessment period. This is the same assessment used for drivers. You must pass this assessment before you can be appointed as a Distribution Manager. What are accountability bar scores? You earn 1 accountability bar score for every 3 qualifying drivers. For example, if 18 drivers qualify, you earn 6 accountability bar scores. These bars accumulate throughout the year and are used to calculate your annual bonus. How is the annual bonus calculated? The annual bonus is calculated by multiplying the set annual amount per accountability bar by the total number of accountability bars you earned in the year. The set annual amount is defined by Zibuke OnCall payroll settings. What is the distribution portal? The distribution portal is a digital tool that helps you plan routes, assign drivers, track progress, monitor calls, view proof, and review performance. It makes your work clearer and more accountable. Your drivers also use a mobile-friendly version of the portal. What are my main duties? Your main duties are planning collection and delivery routes, managing up to 30 drivers, assigning drivers to routes, monitoring driver progress, tracking completed and pending jobs, making sure drivers call customers, supporting drivers when problems arise, and using the distribution portal to manage all distribution work. Do I need specific qualifications? We do not require specific qualifications for this role. We require proof that you can do the work. You will complete an accountability assessment before appointment. This assessment proves you understand distribution, customer service, and responsibility. Apply for Distribution Manager Complete the form below to apply. All fields are required. Your application will be reviewed by the Zibuke OnCall team. APPLICATION SUBMITTED Thank you for applying. The Zibuke OnCall team will review your application. Your reference is . You can track your application at any time using your reference number. Track your application at: zibukeoncall.co.za/track-application

documents.title: Business Management Internship | Zibuke OnCall
documents.text: Business Management Internship | Zibuke OnCall Enquiries: +27 18 007 0525 Contact Us Package Plans Your Career Starts Here Business Management Internship Built for TVET N6 graduates who want to manage teams and build a career. You learn by doing. You earn by leading. You prove yourself through the Accountability Assessment, then manage real sales reps under the guidance of a full time Sales Manager. When your team succeeds, you succeed. Apply Now ↓ Who This Internship Is For You qualify for this internship if you meet every condition below. You studied at a TVET college in South Africa. You completed your N6 certificate or you are in your final trimester to finish your N6. You studied Business Management at the TVET college. You need 24 months of practical workplace experience to receive your National Diploma from DHET. We do not accept candidates from universities of technology, private universities, government universities, or private colleges. Only TVET college N6 Business Management graduates qualify for this programme. Your Working Hours Wednesday to Sunday • 9 hours per day • Monday & Tuesday off Your Path to a Permanent Role Your journey has four clear steps. Every step moves you closer to a permanent position at Zibuke OnCall. You do not need to wonder what comes next. We show you the full path before you start. Register today. Submit your application with your TVET details. Tell us why you deserve this opportunity. We review your application and confirm your place in the Accountability Assessment. Prove yourself in the Accountability Assessment. You sell 45 active subscription plans within 3 months. You earn commission on every sale you make. This assessment shows us you have the discipline to lead a team. It shows you that Zibuke OnCall is a place where performance matters. Start your 24-month internship. You manage 5 sales reps under the guidance of a full time Sales Manager. Your reps have sales targets. You do not. Your focus is building your team, learning management, and completing your logbook for your National Diploma. Become a permanent employee. After 24 months, you are absorbed into Zibuke OnCall as a full employee. No extra interviews. No second guessing. You already proved you belong. Accountability Is the Foundation of Everything We Build Zibuke OnCall operates on one principle: you are what you do. Not what you say you will do. Not what you plan to do. What you actually do. Every person at Zibuke OnCall is measured the same way. Candidates sell 45 plans during the Accountability Assessment. Employees earn bars for exceeding their targets. Managers earn bonuses when their teams deliver. There is no favouritism. There is no guessing. The numbers tell the story. When you join Zibuke OnCall, you step into a system that rewards performance and holds everyone to the same standard. That is fair to you, and it is fair to everyone on your team. The Accountability Assessment: Your Real Interview We do not use traditional interviews. An interview tells us how well you talk about yourself. It does not tell us how well you can work. We replaced interviews with something better: a real chance to prove yourself through real work in real conditions. How the Assessment Works You sell 45 active subscription plans within 3 months. You use the same plans, the same tools, and you serve the same customers as every employee at Zibuke OnCall. Nothing is simulated. Every sale is real. You earn commission on every sale during this phase: Silver plan: 8% of Net Subscription Value Gold plan: 10% of Net Subscription Value Platinum plan: 12% of Net Subscription Value Net Subscription Value is the price minus 15% VAT. You keep what you earn. If you reach 33 sales by the end of month 3, you qualify for a one-month extension. If you reach 45 sales, you pass. That is the moment you enter the internship programme. If you do not reach 45 sales, you keep every commission you earned. You walk away with real money and real experience. You do not walk away with nothing. What You Earn at Every Stage During Assessment Commission only. 8% to 12% of Net Subscription Value per sale. You control how much you earn by how many plans you sell. During Internship Performance bonuses when your team reaches targets. Annual bonuses at the end of each year. No basic salary, no sales targets for you. You earn when your team delivers. Your 24-Month Programme You manage 5 sales reps. You report to a full time Sales Manager who guides you, reviews your decisions, and helps you grow. The Sales Manager does not manage your team. You do. You consult your Sales Manager for advice and approval. This is how you learn to lead while someone with experience watches your back. We reserve the right to move sales reps between teams if they are not performing under your management. This protects the reps and it protects your development. You learn that leadership means making tough decisions about who belongs on your team. Phase 1 · Months 1 to 6 Learn the Sales Process You work alongside experienced sales reps to understand how the sales process works at Zibuke OnCall. You learn the plans, the customer objections, the closing techniques, and the system that tracks every sale. You do not manage a team during this phase. You learn what your future team will experience every day. A Sales Manager assigns you to shadow different reps so you see different selling styles. Sales Management · Customer Service Phase 2 · Months 7 to 12 Manage Your Team You take charge of 5 sales reps. You assign their daily targets, you track their performance, and you coach them through their challenges. You meet with your Sales Manager weekly to review your team's progress and get advice. Your reps have sales targets. You do not. Your job is to make sure your reps succeed. If your team reaches its targets, you earn a performance bonus. No intern will be assigned to a team led by another business management intern. Every intern manages their own independent team. Sales Management · Training Staff · Labour Relations Phase 3 · Months 13 to 18 Strategy and Expansion You work with your Sales Manager to analyse your team's performance data, identify growth opportunities, and plan territory expansion. You learn how to read sales reports, adjust strategies when targets are not being met, and present your findings to management. You also participate in recruitment and training of new sales reps. This phase prepares you for the strategic side of business management. Entrepreneurship · Public Relations · Business Strategy Phase 4 · Months 19 to 24 Compile Your Logbook and Submit for Your Diploma You consolidate all the evidence from your 24 months of work. Your logbook contains signed-off entries from your Sales Manager covering every area of the N6 Business Management curriculum. Your Manager certifies your logbook and you submit it to the Department of Higher Education and Training for your National Diploma. You continue working at Zibuke OnCall while you wait for DHET to process your diploma. Logbook Compilation · Portfolio of Evidence · DHET Submission Your Logbook Covers Every Subject in the N6 Business Management Curriculum Every task your Sales Manager assigns maps to one of the subjects below. When you finish 24 months, your logbook contains verifiable evidence for every subject. There are no gaps. There is no busy work. Every activity builds toward your diploma. Sales Management You manage 5 sales reps. You assign targets, track performance, and coach your team to succeed. Your Manager signs off each phase of your management experience. Labour Relations You handle team dynamics, performance conversations, and the responsibility of moving reps who are not performing. You learn how to manage people fairly and firmly. Entrepreneurship and Business Management You analyse performance data, plan territory growth, and contribute to business strategy discussions with your Sales Manager. You see how a business operates from the inside. Public Relations You communicate with customers, represent Zibuke OnCall in the community, and manage the reputation of your team. Every customer interaction is a PR opportunity. How You Earn Bonuses You do not have sales targets as a Business Management Intern. Your job is to lead your team to success. When your team performs, you earn bonuses. This is how we align your success with the success of the people you manage. Monthly Performance Bonus Team Based You earn a performance bonus every month your team of 12 sales reps reaches their collective sales target. The bonus amount increases as your team hits higher performance levels. Your Sales Manager confirms the bonus based on your team's results. Annual Performance Bonus Team Based You earn an annual bonus when your team reaches their targets consistently throughout the year. This bonus is calculated by the Zibuke OnCall accountability system. It rewards sustained performance, not a single good month. Why You Can Trust This Internship You have probably seen internships that waste your time with tasks that teach you nothing. We do not do that here. Every activity you complete during your 24-month internship is documented in your logbook and counts toward your National Diploma. You are not making coffee. You are not filing papers. You are managing a real team with real targets and real consequences. You rotate through four phases that cover every subject in the N6 Business Management curriculum. Your Sales Manager signs off your logbook entries. When you finish, you do not leave with a certificate and a handshake. You leave as a permanent employee at Zibuke OnCall with a National Diploma from DHET. That is a promise we make to every person who walks this path with us. Apply Now Complete the form below. We review every application personally. If you qualify you will be invited to register for the Accountability Assessment. � Application Submitted Thank you for applying. We review every application personally. You can track your application status at any time using your reference number. This usually takes 3 to 5 business days. Track your application at: zibukeoncall.co.za/track-application.html Reference: generating... Ready to Lead? You have your N6. You need 24 months of experience. We give you a real team, real responsibility, and a real path to your National Diploma and a permanent career. Apply now and start your journey. Apply Now

documents.title: Accountability Assessment | Zibuke OnCall Internships
documents.text: Accountability Assessment | Zibuke OnCall Internships 📞 Enquiries: +27 18 007 0525 📍 Contact Us 📋 Package Plans YOUR PATHWAY IN ACCOUNTABILITY ASSESSMENT You prove yourself through real work. Sell 45 packages and earn your place. Apply Now ↓ 📌 Zibuke OnCall uses two separate accountability systems: The Accountability Assessment is for candidates who are not yet employees. The Accountability Score (measured in bars) is for employees who have already passed their assessment. This page explains both systems so you understand exactly how Zibuke OnCall measures your performance at every stage of your career. ⏰ Your Working Hours Wednesday to Sunday • 9 hours per day • Monday & Tuesday off 📋 Understanding Zibuke OnCall Accountability Zibuke OnCall has two distinct accountability systems that measure your performance at different stages of your career. Understanding both systems before you begin your assessment helps you prepare for what lies ahead. System 1: Accountability Assessment (For Candidates) The Accountability Assessment is your entry into Zibuke OnCall. You are not yet an employee during this phase. The assessment measures whether you can demonstrate the five core qualities we hire for: Resilience, Communication, Care, Accountability, and Generosity. These qualities can only be proven through real work, not through interviews. During the Accountability Assessment, you do not earn bars. You do not earn a salary. You earn commission only on what you produce. The assessment has a specific duration per department, and if you reach the required threshold, you may qualify for a conditional one-month extension. System 2: Accountability Score (For Employees) After you pass the Accountability Assessment and become a permanent employee, you begin earning an Accountability Score measured in bars. Bars measure your ongoing effort and determine your ranking among colleagues. Bars are earned by exceeding your monthly targets. The more bars you earn, the higher you rank, and the larger your annual bonus will be. Bars earned each month reset on the 29th of every month. However, the total bars earned each month are added to your cumulative annual total. Your annual total bars determine how much annual bonus you will receive. The value of each bar is set by the management based on the company's annual profitability, and this value is converted into money one month before the annual bonus is paid. 📊 Accountability Assessment Targets by Department Each department at Zibuke OnCall has its own Accountability Assessment targets and duration. These are the requirements you must meet to pass your assessment and become a permanent employee. Department Assessment Target Duration Extension Threshold Operations (Technicians) 48 repairs without any callback 2 months 28+ repairs by end of month 2 → 1 month extension Logistics (Drivers) 70 collections and deliveries on time 1 month 55+ deliveries by end of month → 1 month extension Revenue (Sales Representative) 45 packages sold directly 3 months 33+ packages by end of month 3 → 1 month extension Revenue (Sales Manager) 12 Sales Rep candidates graduated 3 months 8+ reps reach target by end of month 3 → 1 month extension Important: If you do not reach the extension threshold by the end of your assessment period, no extension is possible. If you do not reach the full target within the extension period, you do not pass the assessment. 📐 Your Assessment Score Calculation Your Accountability Assessment score tells you how close you are to finishing your assessment. It also tells you how much commission you will earn for each sold package, repaired appliance, or delivered job on time. Assessment Score = (Your Progress ÷ Assessment Target) × 100 Examples: Revenue candidate: Sold 23 packages. Score = (23 ÷ 45) × 100 = 51% Operations candidate: Repaired 30 appliances. Score = (30 ÷ 48) × 100 = 63% Logistics candidate: Completed 50 jobs. Score = (50 ÷ 70) × 100 = 71% This score is assigned only to candidates undergoing accountability assessment. It calculates your progress up to the end of your assessment period and automatically creates a one-month extension if you are within the numbers that trigger extensions. 📅 The Zibuke OnCall Monthly Cycle At Zibuke OnCall, the month does not follow the standard calendar. Our monthly cycle runs from the 28th of one month to the 28th of the following month . This affects when you are paid, when your bars reset, and when your performance is measured. Salary Payment Rules: If you sign your employment contract by the 2nd day of the month , you will be paid your full salary on the 28th of that same month. If you sign your employment contract after the 2nd day of the month , your salary will be prorated. Proration formula: Your basic salary for your section ÷ 30 days = daily rate. The daily rate is multiplied by the number of working days (excluding Mondays and Tuesdays, which are off days at Zibuke OnCall). Bar Reset Cycle: Bars earned each month reset on the 29th of every month . The total bars earned that month are added to your cumulative annual total . Your cumulative annual total determines your annual bonus. 🏆 Accountability Score: The Bar System After you pass the Accountability Assessment and become a permanent employee, you begin earning an Accountability Score measured in bars. The bar system measures your ongoing effort and determines your ranking among colleagues. How Bars Are Earned Bars are earned by exceeding your monthly targets. The calculation depends on your role: Role Monthly Target Bars Earned Monthly Bonus Sales Representative 20 new packages per month 1 bar per package above 20 (Subscription - 15% VAT) × new packages Sales Manager At least 3 reps must reach their targets 1 bar per 3 extra packages above target Calculated per extra new package above target How Your Salary Is Calculated After passing your Accountability Assessment, your monthly salary is calculated as follows: For Sales Representatives: Basic Salary: R7,500 + Monthly Bonus = Gross Salary Gross Salary - PAYE (Pay As You Earn tax) - UIF contributions = Net Salary The management also has the ability to add items and amounts to your salary, such as performance bonuses or deductions. You can view your full salary breakdown in your employee portal profile. How Bars Determine Your Annual Bonus Bars earned throughout the year accumulate. At the end of the year, the management sets the value of each bar based on the company's annual profitability. This means: Until the bar value is set, bars show as a number only , not as money. The bar value is converted into money one month before the annual bonus is paid. The annual bonus = your total accumulated bars × the value per bar. Important: All employees are told how the bonus is calculated. This information is shared with candidates undergoing the Accountability Assessment so they understand what they are working toward. 📂 Sections Within Departments Each department can be divided into sections. A section is an employee assigned to a different job within that department. This means accountability assessment and accountability score calculations are set per section, not per department. Why Sections Matter: If a department has different sections, the calculations of accountability are based on the section, not the department. The ongoing accountability score is also calculated based on the set section. Once the management creates a new section for a department, the section's accountability rules replace the department's default rules. Employees working in different sections and doing different jobs can have accountability assessments set specifically for their section. Master User Capabilities: Create new sections within a department Set accountability duties and targets for each section Set monthly targets and bonus calculations for each section Set bar values for annual bonus calculation View change history of all settings in the management portal All changes made by the management are recorded and preserved in the management portal. When a new rule contradicts an existing rule, the old rule is deleted and the new rule becomes the only one followed. 👤 What You Can View in Your Employee Portal Your employee portal profile shows you everything you need to know about your accountability and earnings: Candidates undergoing accountability assessment: You can check your assessment score, see your progress toward your target, and view the commissions you have earned that month. Employees who have passed assessment: You can view your accountability score (bars), your salary breakdown, your monthly bonus, and generate payslips for any month you have been paid. Candidates: You can view your commissions but cannot generate payslips until you pass the assessment and become an employee. On the 28th of every month, a CSV document containing all employee salaries (including interns) is automatically sent for salary processing. Every employee can log in and see what they will be paid or have been paid. Employees can also generate payslips for any month in the past, which show the amount paid, bonus earned, and deductions made. 📊 Business Management 📈 Marketing Management Why We Trust Action Over Words Interviews test how well you perform in an interview. They do not test how well you do the job. You have probably met someone who spoke perfectly in an interview but could not deliver when the real work began. That experience is not fair to you or to us. At Zibuke OnCall, we believe in you enough to let you prove yourself through real work. The Accountability Assessment is your chance to show us what you can do. You demonstrate your ability by actually doing it. We trust you from the start. 🎯 The Benchmark: 45 Packages Your goal is to sell 45 subscription packages . This number tells us something about you that no interview ever could. Resilience: You hear "no" and you keep going. You do not lose motivation when things get hard. Communication: You explain our value clearly and connect with people honestly. Care: You genuinely want to help families protect their appliances. That care turns into trust. Accountability: You own your results. You do not make excuses. You find a way. Generosity: You lead every conversation with the intention to help, not just to close a sale. These five qualities cannot be faked. They can only be earned through action . That is why this assessment exists. When you pass, we know you are someone we can trust. 📊 Business Management Internship This track teaches you sales operations, team coordination, territory management, and business development. You learn how sales teams work together, how territories are managed, and how data guides business decisions. If you see yourself leading teams and managing performance, this is your track. After your assessment, you rotate through sales operations and junior management roles while completing your 24-month practical experience. When you finish the programme, you move into a permanent management or operations role at Zibuke OnCall. 📋 How the Assessment Works 1 Apply Below You submit your application with your chosen track. We check that you meet the basic requirements: an N6 qualification, South African residency, and genuine interest in your selected track. 2 Onboarding and Training If you are accepted, you complete a one week paid onboarding programme. You learn our subscription plans, our appliance categories, how we qualify customers, and how to use our CRM tools. You receive your lead lists and your sales toolkit. 3 Begin the Accountability Assessment You start selling. During this phase, you earn commission only. You receive a percentage of the Net Subscription Value on every sale. Silver plans pay 8 percent, Gold plans pay 10 percent, and Platinum plans pay 12 percent, minus 15 percent VAT. There is no basic salary during the assessment. Your target is 45 packages within 3 months. You have full access to mentorship, sales scripts, and your team lead. 📌 33-Package Milestone: To qualify for a possible extension, you must have sold at least 33 packages by the end of your third month. If you reach 33, you may be granted a single one month extension at your manager's discretion to close the remaining 12. If you are below 33 at month 3, no extension is possible. 4 Pass and Transition to Internship When you sell your 45th package, you are confirmed into the 24-month internship programme. You begin earning your R4,500 monthly stipend. You start your track-specific practical experience, rotating between managers and supervisors. Every activity is documented in your logbook for your diploma. You are not required to sell a minimum number of packages each month. You do not earn performance bonuses during the internship. Your focus is on completing the workplace activities assigned to you. 5 Graduate and Join Zibuke OnCall When you complete the 24-month programme, you move into a permanent role at Zibuke OnCall. There are no additional interviews. There are no further assessments. Your 45 sales proved what you can do. You transition into full-time employment with full employee benefits. 📋 What Happens After You Pass Your Logbook Every activity you complete during your 24-month internship is documented in your logbook as required for your diploma. Your manager and supervisor assign tasks that count toward your N6 practical experience. You are not required to sell a minimum number of packages each month. You do not receive monthly performance bonuses. Your focus is on completing the workplace activities assigned to you. Working With Different Managers You work with different managers and supervisors throughout the programme. This gives you experience across multiple functions within Zibuke OnCall. Each manager or supervisor assigns you activities that count toward your logbook. Your Sales Manager A Sales Manager oversees your overall guidance. You do not form part of the manager's core team of twelve Sales Representatives. Each manager may work with between one and three interns at a time. You may be moved between managers or new interns may join over time. You report to your manager for mentorship while rotating to other supervisors for track-specific experience. When your internship ends, you transition into a permanent role. Logbook Signatures Your supervisor or manager signs your logbook when you complete your assigned work. If you do not perform your duties according to their instructions, you will not receive their signature. Interns whose logbooks have missing or unsigned sections will be released from the programme. This protects the integrity of your qualification and ensures you earn your diploma through genuine work. ⚠️ If You Do Not Reach 45 If you do not reach 45 sales within the assessment period, you will not pass. You are never employed at Zibuke OnCall before passing the Accountability Assessment. We cannot register you with the Department of Labour unless you have passed. You keep every commission you earned on your sales. This outcome is better than a traditional interview rejection because you walk away with real experience and real earnings. If you sold at least 33 packages by the end of month three, your manager may grant you a single one month extension. Below 33 at month three, the process ends at the 90-day mark. Register for the Accountability Assessment This form registers you to undergo the Accountability Assessment for your chosen internship track. You do not become an intern by submitting this form. You become an intern by passing the Accountability Assessment, which means selling 45 active subscriptions within three months. Once you pass, your manager confirms you and you begin the 24-month internship programme. Choose your track. We do not ask for your CV. We ask for your commitment. ✅ APPLICATION SUBMITTED Hi , Thank you for applying to Zibuke OnCall . We have received your application and the management will review it within 5 business days. Application reference: Position applied for: You can track your application status at any time using your reference number. Track your application at: zibukeoncall.co.za/track-application.html The Zibuke OnCall team Queries: [email�protected] | Office Hours: Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM SAST ← Back to Careers Hub

documents.text: Driver Accountability Assessment | Zibuke OnCall Careers 📞 Enquiries: +27 18 007 0525 📍 Contact Us 📋 Package Plans LOGISTICS DEPARTMENT DRIVER ACCOUNTABILITY ASSESSMENT You earn your permanent Driver position by completing 70 real collection and delivery jobs within 1 month. No interviews. No guessing. Just your work speaking for you. Apply Now ↓ 📌 Zibuke OnCall Accountability: The Logistics department assessment requires completing 70 collections and deliveries on time within 1 month . If you have completed 55 deliveries on time by the end of the month, you will be given a conditional one-month extension. This page explains how the assessment works and what you can expect. ⏰ Your Working Hours Wednesday to Sunday • 9 hours per day • Monday & Tuesday off Why You Will Not Sit Through an Interview You have probably sat in an interview before where the person who got the job was simply better at talking about themselves. That is not fair to you. A 30 minute conversation tells us nothing about how you handle a customer's appliance, how you navigate traffic to arrive on time, or how you treat someone's home when you walk through their door. At Zibuke OnCall, you earn your position by doing the actual work. We hand you the keys, the route, and the responsibility. You show us who you are through every collection and every delivery. That is the Accountability Assessment. It is the only interview that matters. 🚚 What 70 Jobs Means for You You pass the Accountability Assessment and earn your permanent Driver position by completing 70 real collection and delivery jobs . This number is not random. It is the exact point where we can trust you completely with our customers and their appliances. Here is what you prove along the way: Reliability: You arrive when you say you will. Customers are waiting for you to collect or deliver their appliance. When you show up on time, every time, you build the kind of trust that keeps people choosing Zibuke OnCall. Care: You treat every appliance as if you paid for it yourself. No scratches. No dents. You walk into someone's home and you leave it exactly as you found it, except they now have a working appliance. Communication: You pick up the phone when something changes. If there is a delay, you tell the customer before they have to wonder. If you cannot find the address, you ask. You never leave someone guessing. Accountability: You own every job from start to finish. Traffic is not an excuse. A flat tyre is a problem you solve. You find a way to keep your promise because that is who you are. Generosity: You bring kindness to every doorstep. A genuine smile. A moment of patience. The way you carry someone's appliance shows them you care. Customers remember how you made them feel. You cannot fake these five qualities in an interview. You can only show them through 70 real jobs . That is why this assessment exists. We trust people who prove themselves, and you will be one of them. 📋 How Your Assessment Works 1 You Apply Below You fill in the form with your details and answer three questions. We check that you hold a valid driver's licence, you live in South Africa, and you are genuinely interested in logistics work. We read every application personally. 2 You Start Your Assessment Once you are accepted, you begin completing real collection and delivery jobs. Our Logistics Manager guides you through the process. You earn a commission on every job you complete. You use our vehicles, our fuel, and you receive support every step of the way. During the assessment period, you earn commission only. 3 You Complete 70 Jobs Your goal is to complete 70 jobs within 1 month . Every job you complete must be confirmed by the customer. You have 30 days to reach this number, and you have full access to our vehicles, fuel, and the Logistics Manager's support throughout. 📌 55-Delivery Milestone: To qualify for a possible extension, you must have completed at least 55 deliveries on time by the end of your first month. If you reach 55, you may be granted a single one-month extension at your manager's discretion to complete the remaining 15. If you are below 55 at the end of the month, no extension is possible. 4 You Earn Your Permanent Position The moment you complete your 70th job, you are a permanent Driver at Zibuke OnCall. You move to a full salary with benefits. You have already proven that you are reliable, careful, and accountable. That proof is worth more than any interview could ever be. ⚠️ If You Do Not Reach 70 Jobs If you do not complete 70 jobs within the 1-month assessment period, you will not pass. If you completed 55 deliveries on time by the end of the month, you will receive a one-month extension. If you still do not reach 70 by the end of the extension, you do not pass. But here is what matters: you keep every commission you earned. You leave with real work experience, real earnings, and a real reference. That is more than any interview rejection gives you. Register for Your Driver Assessment This form is how you start your Accountability Assessment for the Driver position. Submitting this form does not make you an employee. You become a permanent Driver when you complete 70 jobs within 1 month. That is when you have truly earned your place. ✅ APPLICATION SUBMITTED Hi , Thank you for applying to Zibuke OnCall . We have received your application and the management will review it within 5 business days. Application reference: Position applied for: You can track your application status at any time using your reference number. documents.title: Employee Portal Guide | Zibuke OnCall
documents.text: Employee Portal Guide | Zibuke OnCall Portal Guide Your Portal Your Work Your Future This guide shows you exactly how to use the Zibuke OnCall employee portal. Every tab, every feature, every action. You will know what to do from your first day. Quick Navigation How to Access Your Portal Understanding Your Dashboard Sales Representative Portal Guide Sales Manager Portal Guide Technician Portal Guide Driver Portal Guide Distribution Manager Portal Guide Technical Manager Portal Guide Intern Portal Guide Understanding Accountability Bars Weekly Reports Salary and Payslips Messages and Communication Password and Security How to Access Your Portal You received an email with your temporary password when your manager created your account. That email came from Zibuke OnCall. It contains everything you need to sign in for the first time. 1 Go to the portal page Open your browser and go to zibukeoncall.co.za/my-account. You will see three options. Choose Employee. This takes you to the employee login page. 2 Enter your email and password Use the email address your manager registered for you. Use the temporary password from the email. Click Sign In. 3 Change your password immediately The system will ask you to create a new password. Choose something only you know. Your new password must be at least eight characters. Write it down somewhere safe. 4 You are now inside your portal Your dashboard is the first thing you see. It shows your role, your accountability bars, and the tabs you are allowed to use. Only the tabs that matter to your job are visible. Everything else stays hidden. If you are an intern, you will be redirected to the intern portal after login. That portal has everything you need for your internship logbook and evidence uploads. Understanding Your Dashboard Every employee sees the same dashboard layout. The difference is what content appears inside. Your role determines which stats, which tabs, and which tools you can access. What You Always See Your name and initials in the top right corner Your job role displayed as a stat card Your accountability bars for the current month Your annual accountability bars and estimated bonus A leaderboard showing your team members ranked by bars earned What Changes Based on Your Role A sales representative sees different tabs than a technician. A driver sees different tools than a manager. The portal shows you only what you need. Nothing extra. Nothing confusing. Every tab you see is there because your job requires it. Dashboard Salary 💬 Messages Contacts Voice Notes Reports Password Training This is what a sales representative sees. Eight tabs that power their entire workday. Every tool exists to help them sell, communicate, and track their success. Dashboard Contacts Salary 💬 Messages Voice Notes Reports Employees Careers Admin Password Training This is what a master user sees. Many more tabs because they manage the entire organisation. Sales Representative Portal Guide Your job is to help families protect their appliances by explaining repair plans honestly. Your portal gives you the tools to do this well. Every feature exists to support your success. Your Assessment Phase (Phase 1) Before you earn a salary, you prove yourself through real work. You sell 45 active subscription packages within three months. This is your Accountability Assessment. The portal tracks every sale you make. Your progress bar shows exactly how close you are to graduation. What You Do Every Day Open the Dashboard. See your current month bars, your target progress, and where you rank among your colleagues Open the Contacts tab. This is where customer conversations happen. When a customer messages you, it appears here. Respond quickly. Respond honestly. Every conversation builds trust Submit your Monday and Friday reports. Tell your manager what you did this week. What went well. What was hard. Honesty matters more than perfection Check your Salary tab. See your earnings. If you are in Phase 1, you see your commission history. If you graduated to Phase 2, you see your salary and bonuses How Your Bars Work You earn one accountability bar for every package sold above your monthly target of 20. Sell 25 packages and you earn 5 bars. Sell 30 and you earn 10 bars. These bars add up over the year. They determine your annual bonus. The more bars you earn, the more you earn at the end of the year. Your accountability bars reset on the 29th of every month. But they are added to your annual total. Every bar counts. Every sale matters. Contacts Tab This is where you communicate with customers who are interested in repair plans. When a customer sends a message, it appears in your Contacts list. You see their name, their message preview, and whether they have unread messages. Click on a conversation to open it. Respond with care. Every message you send represents Zibuke OnCall. Messages Tab The Messages tab connects you with your team and your customers. Use it for one on one conversations and group chats. Ask questions. Share what works. Celebrate wins. Your colleagues are going through the same journey. Support each other. Sales Manager Portal Guide You lead a core team of 12 sales representatives. Your job is to help them succeed. The portal gives you visibility into their progress and the tools to support them. Your Dashboard Your dashboard shows your team's performance. You see who is hitting their targets. Who needs help. Who is excelling. The leaderboard displays your team members ranked by accountability bars. Use this information to guide your coaching conversations. What You Do Every Day Review your team's bars. Open the Dashboard and look at the leaderboard. Know where each person stands Check the Contacts tab. See the conversations your team members are having with customers. Step in when a conversation needs management attention Submit your weekly reports. Tell the master user about your team's performance. What targets were met. What challenges exist Use the Careers tab if you have it. Review job applications. Transition candidates through the hiring pipeline How You Earn Bonus Bars As a Sales Manager, you earn manager bonus bars when your team performs well. These bars are separate from your personal sales bars. They reward you for developing your people. The better your team does, the more bonus bars you earn. Creating Team Members When a new sales representative joins your team, you create their account through the portal. Go to the Employees tab. Click Create Team Member. Enter their details. Choose their role. The system sends them a temporary password by email. They sign in and change it on their first login. Technician Portal Guide You repair appliances. Your skill keeps families running. The portal tracks your repairs and shows your progress through the Accountability Assessment. Your Assessment Phase You must complete 48 repairs without callback within two months. The portal tracks every repair you log. Your progress bar shows how many repairs you have completed. Your callback count shows whether your work meets quality standards. What You Do Every Day Open the Assignments tab. See the appliances assigned to you. Each assignment shows the appliance type, brand, model, serial number, and customer details Log your repairs. Open the Log Repair tab. Enter the booking number, what you fixed, what parts you used, and whether the repair is complete Mark repairs as complete. When you finish a repair, click Mark Complete on the assignment card. This updates your progress bars immediately Submit your weekly reports. Tell your manager about your week. Which repairs were difficult. What parts you needed. What you learned Assignments Tab This tab shows every appliance waiting for your attention. You see the appliance type, brand, model, and serial number. You see the customer name and when the assignment was made. When you complete a repair, click the green Mark Complete button. The system records your repair and updates your bars. Log Repair Tab This is where you document your work. Enter the booking reference. Describe the problem you found. Describe the repair you performed. List any parts you used. This record proves your accountability. It protects you and the customer. Every repair you complete without callback earns you toward your assessment target. Quality matters as much as quantity. Do the job right the first time. Driver Portal Guide You collect and deliver appliances. You are the last person the customer sees. Your professionalism represents the entire company. The portal helps you manage your routes and prove your accountability. Your Assessment Phase You must complete 70 collection and delivery jobs on time within one month. The portal tracks every job you log. Your progress bar shows how many jobs you have completed. Your on time percentage shows whether you are meeting the standard. What You Do Every Day Open the Routes tab. See today's route with every stop listed. Each stop shows the customer name, phone number, address, and whether it is a collection or delivery Log your jobs. Open the Log Job tab. Enter the booking number, what you collected or delivered, and whether the job was completed successfully Report delays immediately. If a customer is not home, if an address is wrong, if traffic is bad, report it through the portal. Your manager needs to know Submit your weekly reports. Tell your manager about your week. How many jobs you completed. Any challenges you faced Routes Tab This tab shows your planned route for the day. Every stop is listed in order. You see the customer name, phone number, and address. You see whether each stop is a collection or a delivery. You see the scheduled time window. Work through your route in order. Update each stop as you complete it. Log Job Tab This is where you record every collection and delivery. Enter the booking reference. Select whether it was a collection or delivery. Confirm the appliance details. The system updates your job count and your on time percentage. Every job you complete on time earns you toward your assessment target. The customer is trusting you with their appliance. Respect that trust. Distribution Manager Portal Guide You plan routes. You lead up to 30 drivers. You protect the promise we make to every customer. The portal is your command centre. Your Assessment Phase You must complete 70 jobs on time within one month. This proves you understand the work your drivers do. After you pass, you manage the distribution team full time. What You Do Every Day Open the Routes tab. See every route planned for the day. See which drivers are assigned. See which routes are on track and which are delayed Monitor driver progress. The dashboard shows drivers on route, drivers not started, on time percentage, and average route completion time Plan new routes. Create routes and assign drivers based on location, workload, and timing Review customer calls. See which drivers called customers and which did not. Follow up where needed Check performance reports. The dashboard shows daily, weekly, and monthly performance for every driver What You Earn Your base salary is R10,000 per month (the default fallback for the `logistics_manager` role in `src/handlers/salary.js`). The code does not implement a driver-count monthly bonus or a qualifying-driver bar rule — if such a bonus is intended, the master must configure it as a salary rule. Your drivers need you to plan routes that work. They need you to support them when customers are difficult. They need you to hold them accountable when they do not do the work. Be that person. Technical Manager Portal Guide You lead up to 25 technicians at the workshop. Your job is to make sure every repair is done right. The portal helps you track quality and manage your team. What You Do Every Day Review the Assignments tab. See which technicians have which appliances. Spot bottlenecks before they become problems Monitor callback rates. A callback means a repair was not done right. Track which technicians have callbacks and coach them to improve Assign technicians to repairs. Match the right technician to the right appliance based on skill and availability Submit your weekly reports. Tell the master about workshop performance. Parts availability. Technician progress What You Earn Note: the codebase defines no `technical_manager` salary default and no hire path for it (`careers.js` only creates `sales_manager`, `sales_rep`, or `intern` employee roles; the salary fallback covers technician at R10,000). A Technical Manager salary must be configured by the master before it can be paid. Intern Portal Guide You are building your future. Your internship is 24 months of real work that leads to your National Diploma. The intern portal is where you manage your logbook, upload evidence, and track your progress. How to Access Your Portal When you sign in at the employee portal with your email and password, the system recognizes your role as intern. It redirects you automatically to the intern portal. You do not need to navigate there manually. Your Dashboard Your dashboard shows your current month number out of 24. It shows how many logbook entries you have. It shows how many evidence files you have uploaded. It shows your commission earnings if you are on the Business Management or Marketing Management internship. What You Do Every Day Open the Logbook tab. See all your logbook entries. Each entry has a date, subject, description, and status. Entries with a green Signed status have been approved by your supervisor. Entries with a yellow Pending status are waiting for review Open the Evidence tab. Upload photos, documents, and files that prove your work. Every piece of evidence supports your logbook entries. The more evidence you upload, the stronger your diploma application Open the Commission tab. If you are on the Business Management or Marketing Management internship, see the commissions you have earned. Track your sales during the Accountability Assessment period Logbook Tab Your logbook is the record of your internship. Every task you complete, every skill you learn, every customer you help goes here. Add a new entry by filling in the subject and description. Your supervisor reviews and signs each entry. Signed entries count toward your 18 month logbook requirement. Evidence Tab Evidence proves what you have done. Upload photos of work you completed. Upload documents you created. Upload files that show your skills. Every upload is saved to your portfolio. When you apply for your National Diploma, this evidence supports your application. Your internship is not just a job. It is the foundation of your career. Treat every logbook entry and every piece of evidence as an investment in your future. Understanding Accountability Bars Accountability bars are how Zibuke OnCall measures your contribution. They are not punishment. They are proof. Every bar you earn represents real work you did for real customers. How Bars Work Every role has a monthly target. A sales representative must sell 20 packages per month. A technician must complete a set number of repairs. A driver must complete a set number of jobs. When you exceed your target, you earn bars for each unit above the target. Where You See Your Bars Your bars are always visible on your dashboard. You see your monthly bars and your annual total. The monthly bars show what you earned this month. The annual total shows everything you earned since January. Your estimated annual bonus is calculated from your annual total. When Bars Reset Monthly bars reset on the 29th of every month. But they are not lost. They are added to your annual total before they reset. Every bar you earn counts toward your year end bonus. The management sets the value of each bar based on the company's annual profitability. Why Bars Matter Bars are the fairest way to measure performance. They are based on results, not opinions. They are based on what you did, not who you know. Every employee is measured the same way. The person with the most bars at the end of the year earns the highest bonus. That is accountability. Weekly Reports Weekly reports keep your manager informed about your work. They take two minutes to write. They make a real difference in how your manager supports you. Monday Report Write your Monday report at the start of the week. Tell your manager what you plan to accomplish. What targets you are aiming for. What challenges you expect. This sets the tone for the week. Friday Report Write your Friday report at the end of the week. Tell your manager what you achieved. What went well. What was difficult. What you need help with. Honesty matters more than sounding perfect. How to Submit Open the Reports tab in your portal Choose Monday or Friday Write your report in the text box Click Submit Your manager sees it immediately Your reports help your manager help you. If you are struggling, say so. If you are winning, share that too. Your manager cannot support you if they do not know what you need. Salary and Payslips Your Salary tab shows your earnings. You see your current month net salary. You see your year to date total. You see your salary history for every month this year. What You See Current month net salary at the top Year to date net salary below that A table showing every month this year with base salary, bonus, gross, deductions, net, and status A payslip download button for each month If You Are a Candidate If you are still in your Accountability Assessment, you see your commission history instead of salary. This shows every commission you earned during Phase 1. When you graduate to Phase 2, your salary information appears here. If You Are the Master User The master user sees additional options. Salary rules for the organisation. The ability to process payroll. The ability to generate payslips for all employees. These tools are for master use only. Messages and Communication Communication keeps the team together. The Messages tab connects you with your colleagues and customers. You can send text messages. You can send voice notes. You can share updates. How to Use Messages Open the Messages tab Select a conversation from the list on the left or start a new one Type your message in the text box at the bottom Click the send button To send a voice note, click the microphone icon and record your message. The voice note is sent automatically when you stop recording. Your message appears in the conversation for everyone to see Customer Messages The Customers tab shows messages from customers. These are one on one conversations. When a customer sends a message, it appears here. Respond promptly. Respond with care. Every message is a chance to build trust. Voice Notes Voice notes let you send audio messages. They are useful when typing is not practical. You might be on a route. You might be at a customer's home. Record a voice note instead of typing. Your team hears your voice and understands your message. Password and Security Your password protects your account. It protects your salary information. It protects your accountability records. Keep it safe. Change it regularly. Never share it. Operating Hours Zibuke OnCall operates Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM SAST. This is 9 hours per day. Monday and Tuesday are off days. The monthly cycle runs from the 28th of one month to the 28th of the next month. Accountability bars reset on the 29th of every month. How to Change Your Password Open the Password tab in your portal Enter your current password Enter your new password Confirm your new password Click Change Password Password Requirements Your password must be at least eight characters long. Use a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols. Do not use your name. Do not use your email. Do not use common words. Choose something only you would know. If You Forget Your Password Go to the employee login page. Click Forgot your password. Enter your email address. Check your email for a reset code. Enter the code and your new password. You are back inside your portal. Your account is your responsibility. If someone else uses your password, the actions are traced to you. Protect your account like you protect your reputation. Your Portal Is Your Workplace Every tab in your portal exists because your job matters. Every feature is built to help you succeed. Every record you create proves your accountability. Use your portal every day. It is the foundation of your career at Zibuke OnCall. Open Your Portal

documents.text: Privacy Policy | Zibuke OnCall 📞 Enquiries: +27 18 007 0525 📍 Contact Us 📋 Package Plans 🔧 Get a quote | Sign in Privacy Policy Last updated: June 2026 · Applies to zibukeoncall.co.za and all sub-pages. Your privacy is something we take seriously. We protect your personal information the way we would want ours protected, fully in line with South Africa's Protection of Personal Information Act. 1. Who we are Zibuke OnCall is part of the Services Division of Zibuke Africa (Pty) Ltd. We run the website zibukeoncall.co.za and provide appliance collection, repair, and delivery services to homes across South Africa. If you have any questions about your privacy, you can reach us directly at [email�protected] or call us on +27 18 007 0525. We are here to help you. 2. What information we collect 2.1 Information you give us Your account details such as your name, email, phone number, and password (we store your password securely in a scrambled format). Information about your appliances including the type, brand, model, and serial numbers of the items you register with us. Your payment information such as your chosen plan, how often you pay, the amount, and the sales representative who helped you. Your booking details including your collection address, preferred date and time, and a description of what is wrong with your appliance. If you apply for a job with us, we collect your name, email, phone, location, and your responses to three short questions. When you contact us through our form, we collect your name, email, phone, subject, and your message. 2.2 Information collected automatically Standard server logs that include your IP address and browser type. Cloudflare keeps these records to protect the site from security threats. General website statistics such as page views and where visitors come from. This information does not identify you personally. 3. Why we collect it To deliver the service you signed up for. We need your information to collect, repair, and return your appliances. To keep you updated on your bookings and repairs. You will receive confirmations and status updates so you always know where your appliance is. To process your job application or respond to your message. You can withdraw your consent at any time. To meet our legal obligations under South African tax and accounting law. To protect your account from fraud and unauthorised access. We monitor for suspicious activity to keep your information safe. 4. Where your data is stored Your data is stored securely in Cloudflare D1, a database that runs on Cloudflare's global network. We protect your password by converting it into a scrambled format using industry standard security methods. Your actual password is never stored in a readable form and is never written to our logs. 5. Who can see your data Only the people who need your information to help you can see it. Here is exactly who has access: Your sales representative can see your name, phone number, and appliance details so they can assist you properly. Our technicians and drivers can see your booking details including your address and what is wrong with your appliance so they can collect or repair it. Managers and supervisors see team performance summaries, not your personal details. We will never sell, rent, or trade your personal information to anyone. Your data stays with us. 6. Cookies and local storage Our website uses minimal browser storage to give you a better experience: We use sessionStorage to keep you logged in while you browse. This clears automatically when you close your browser tab. We use localStorage to save your appliance and booking information on your device so the site works even when your connection drops. You can clear this by clearing your browser data. We do not use advertising cookies or track you across other websites. Your browsing habits are your own business. 7. Your rights under POPIA You have real control over your personal information. Here is what you can do: You can ask us to show you what personal information we have about you. You can ask us to fix or update any information that is wrong or outdated. You can ask us to delete your account and your data. We will honour this unless the law requires us to keep certain records. You can object to how we use your information if you believe it is not being used fairly. You can lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator of South Africa if you feel your rights have not been respected. To use any of these rights, send an email to [email�protected] with the subject line "Privacy Request". We will respond to you within 30 days. 8. How long we keep your data We keep your account information for as long as your account is active, plus five years after you close it to meet tax requirements. We keep your booking and payment records for five years from the date of each transaction. If you apply for a job, we keep your application for twelve months from the date you submitted it. For employees, performance records are kept for twenty four months and then converted into anonymous team statistics. 9. Security We use strong security measures to protect your data. Every connection to our site is encrypted. Your password is stored in a secure scrambled format. We use individual authentication tokens and strict access controls so only the right people can see your information. Cloudflare's global security network adds another layer of protection against attacks. We take your security seriously because we know you are trusting us with your personal details. 10. Changes to this policy If we make important changes to this policy, we will let you know with a banner on our website at least fourteen days before the changes take effect. You can always check the "Last updated" date at the top of this page to see the current version. 11. Contact Your privacy matters to us and we want you to feel confident about how we handle your information. If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out to us. Information Officer: Zibuke OnCall Email: [email�protected] Phone: +27 18 007 0525 Postal: Zibuke Africa, P.O. Box [TBC], South Africa View Terms & Conditions Back to Home

documents.text: Terms & Conditions | Zibuke OnCall 📞 Enquiries: +27 18 007 0525 📍 Contact Us 📋 Package Plans 🔧 Get a quote | Sign in Terms & Conditions Last updated: June 2026 When you use our website or sign up for a repair plan, you are agreeing to the terms below. We wrote them to protect you and to make sure we deliver on every promise we make. 1. What these words mean "Zibuke OnCall", "we", "us", "our" means Zibuke OnCall, the appliance repair division of Zibuke Africa (Pty) Ltd. "Customer", "you", "your" means the person who creates an account, subscribes to a repair plan, or books a collection. "Plan" means the Silver, Gold, or Platinum subscription you choose. "Repair" means the full service of collecting, diagnosing, fixing, and returning your appliance. 2. Your account You need to be at least 18 years old to register or subscribe. Please share accurate information so we can serve you properly. Your password is yours alone. We will never ask you for it by phone, email, or SMS. Each household gets one account. If you create more than one, we may combine or suspend them. 3. Your repair plan We offer three plans with different monthly or annual fees and parts allowance. You can see the current details on our Package Plans page, and those details form part of these terms. 3.1 Monthly billing If you pay monthly, you can book a collection after you have made 6 monthly payments. This waiting period keeps the service fair and affordable for everyone. 3.2 Annual billing When you pay annually, you get 12 months of cover for the price of 10. You can book a collection immediately after your payment clears. 3.3 What your plan covers We collect your appliance from your home. Our technician diagnoses the fault and carries out the repair. We replace parts up to the value your plan allows, shared across all your registered items. We deliver your repaired appliance back to you. 3.4 What your plan does not cover Broken TV screens or panels of any kind. Cosmetic damage that does not stop the appliance from working. Damage from misuse, neglect, lightning, power surges, flooding, fire, or theft. Appliances still under a manufacturer or extended warranty. Commercial appliances. Our plans are for household use only. Appliances older than 10 years when you register them. Our technician will assess these before we confirm cover. 4. How the repair process works Register each appliance with its type, brand, model, and serial number in your portal. Book a collection time through the website or by calling us. We will confirm availability. A driver arrives at your address at the agreed time. You or an authorised adult must be there to hand over the appliance. Our technician diagnoses the fault. If the repair cost is more than your plan covers, we will call you with a quote before we proceed. Once the repair is complete, we return your appliance to you, usually within 5 to 10 working days. 5. Your loyalty reward Every 12 months you go without booking a service, your monthly payment drops by 30 percent until it reaches zero. This reward starts once your total payments have passed 160 percent of your plan's parts allowance value. You can track your progress in your Customer Portal . 6. Cancelling your plan and getting a refund Monthly plans: You can cancel whenever you like. Your cover stays active until the end of the current billing cycle. We do not offer pro-rata refunds. Annual plans: You can cancel within 14 days of payment for a full refund, as long as you have not booked a collection. After 14 days, the annual fee is non-refundable unless we billed you twice by mistake. We process refunds to your original payment method within 10 business days. 7. Pricing We review our prices once a year. If your plan price changes, we will give you at least 30 days' notice in writing. If you keep paying after the notice period, that counts as your acceptance of the new price. 8. Using our website By using our site, you agree not to: Use it for anything illegal. Try to access parts of the site, other accounts, or systems you are not authorised to use. Use automated tools like bots or scrapers to access the site without our written permission. Upload viruses, malware, or any harmful code. 9. Our content Everything on this site, from the words to the images to the code, belongs to Zibuke Africa (Pty) Ltd and is protected by South African and international copyright law. 10. Our responsibility to you If something goes wrong, our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the issue arose. We are not responsible for indirect or unexpected losses. We want you to know exactly where you stand with us. 11. The law that applies South African law governs these terms. Any dispute will be handled in the South African courts that have jurisdiction over the area where Zibuke Africa is based. 12. Talk to us If you have any questions about these terms, email [email�protected] or call us on +27 18 007 0525. We are here to help. View Privacy Policy Back to Home
