documents.text: Refund Policy | Zibuke OnCall ZIBUKE ONCALL | REFUND POLICY Effective Date: January 1, 2026 Last Updated: June 11, 2026 Version: 2.1 1. OVERVIEW This Refund Policy explains when and how Zibuke OnCall provides refunds. It applies to all our home services subscription plans and our Master Practice Modules training course. Our subscription plans include: - Appliance Repair Plans (Silver, Gold, Platinum) — monthly or annual billing - Electrical Plan — R2,900 per year (annual only) - Plumbing Plan — R3,300 per year (annual only) - Handyman Plan — R3,500 per year (annual only) We wrote this policy to be clear and fair. We believe you deserve to know exactly where you stand before you commit to anything. That is how we build trust. This policy follows the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008 (South Africa). Your statutory rights are always protected. 2. DEFINITIONS Term Definition Subscription Plan Any home services plan purchased by the customer (Appliance Repair Silver/Gold/Platinum, Electrical Plan, Plumbing Plan, or Handyman Plan) Appliance Repair Plan The monthly or annual plan (Silver, Gold, or Platinum) covering appliance collection, repair, and delivery Electrical Plan The annual plan (R2,900/year) covering electrical fault finding, plug repairs, lighting, and Certificate of Compliance by a registered Wireman Plumbing Plan The annual plan (R3,300/year) covering geyser repairs, leaking taps, toilet repairs, and unblocking by a PIRB-registered plumber Handyman Plan The annual plan (R3,500/year) covering roof leaks, door replacements, window glass, and cupboard repairs by skilled technicians Subscription Fee The monthly payment for the chosen repair plan Repair Service The collection, diagnosis, repair, and delivery of appliances Waiting Period The first 6 months of subscription during which repairs cannot be booked Quotation The cost estimate provided after diagnosis, including delivery and labour costs Warranty Period 6 months from the date of completed repair Master Practice Modules The 6-month workplace preparation course for appliance repair Application Fee The R950 fee paid when submitting an MPM application Registration Fee The R4,000 fee paid after MPM application approval to secure your place Monthly Installment The R3,200 payment due at the end of each programme month Upfront Payment The R17,500 one-time payment that covers all MPM fees Data Subject You, the person whose personal information we process Information Officer The person responsible for POPIA compliance at Zibuke OnCall 3. SUBSCRIPTION FEE REFUNDS 3.1 Cooling-Off Period You have 7 business days from your initial subscription payment to request a full refund. This applies only if you have not registered any appliances, booked any repair services, or initiated any claims. We offer this because we want you to feel confident about your decision. If our service is not right for you within those 7 days, you should be able to walk away without losing anything. How to request: Email [email protected] with your account details and reason for cancellation. Processing time: Refunds are processed within 14 business days of receiving your request. 3.2 Monthly Subscription Refunds Monthly subscription fees are non-refundable once the billing cycle has begun. This is because we allocate resources, schedule technicians, and prepare logistics based on your subscription at the start of each month. There are four exceptions where we will refund you: Scenario Refund Service not provided due to our error Full refund of affected month Duplicate payment Full refund of duplicate amount System error resulting in overcharge Refund of overcharged amount Service suspension due to our technical issues Pro-rata refund for affected days If something goes wrong on our side, we take responsibility. That is not a slogan. That is how we operate. 3.3 Annual Home Services Plan Refunds (Electrical, Plumbing, Handyman) The Electrical Plan, Plumbing Plan, and Handyman Plan are annual-only subscriptions. These plans provide on-site services delivered by qualified, certified technicians at your home. - Within first 7 business days: Full refund (cooling-off period), provided no service call-outs have been booked or completed - After 7 business days, no services used: No refund for the current annual period - After 7 business days, services used: No refund. Service call-outs that have been completed count as services used. - Service termination by us: Pro-rata refund for remaining complete months of the annual period What counts as a service used: - Any completed service call-out (electrical, plumbing, or handyman) - Any Certificate of Compliance issued under the Electrical Plan - Any PIRB Certificate issued under the Plumbing Plan - Any materials used from your plan's annual materials allowance These annual plans give you immediate access to services with no waiting period. Because of this, the cooling-off period is the only window for a full refund. 3.4 Annual Subscription Refunds (Appliance Plans) If you have paid for an annual subscription in advance: - Within first 7 business days: Full refund (cooling-off period) - After 7 business days: No refund for unused months, unless service was not provided due to our error - Service termination by us: Pro-rata refund for remaining months 3.4 Refund Exceptions No refund will be provided if: - You have violated our Terms of Service - Your account has been suspended or terminated due to fraudulent activity - You have outstanding payments or unpaid invoices - The subscription was purchased through a third-party reseller (contact the reseller directly) - You have made a claim during the subscription period 4. REPAIR SERVICE REFUNDS 4.1 Quotation Declined After Diagnosis If we diagnose your appliance and you decide not to proceed with the repair, you only pay for the delivery cost (collection and return of the appliance). There are no labour or parts charges. We believe you should never feel trapped into a repair. The diagnosis is free. The decision is yours. 4.2 Repair Not Possible If we cannot repair your appliance after diagnosis, we refund any labour charges you paid. Parts charges are also refunded if parts were ordered but not used. The delivery cost is not refunded because the collection and return service was provided. We were there. We tried. We are honest about the result. 4.3 Repair Completed but Appliance Still Faulty If your appliance is returned and the original fault is still there, we re-collect and re-repair it at no additional cost. If re-repair is not possible, we refund the labour charges in full. This is our accountability. If we said we fixed it and we did not, we make it right. 4.4 Repair Causes Additional Damage If our repair causes additional damage to your appliance, we repair that damage at no cost to you. If repair is not possible, we compensate you at the current market value of the appliance and refund the original repair charges in full. This does not apply to pre-existing damage or damage that was disclosed before the repair. We take full responsibility for our work. If we make it worse, we fix it or we pay for it. 4.5 Warranty Claims (6-Month Warranty) Every repair comes with a 6-month warranty . If the same fault recurs, or a related fault caused by our repair appears, we re-repair it free of charge or give you a full refund. Issue Resolution Same fault recurs Free re-repair or full refund Related fault (caused by original repair) Free re-repair or full refund Unrelated fault New repair at standard rates Parts failure (original parts) Free replacement parts and labour Parts failure (aftermarket parts) Free replacement with genuine parts How to claim: 1. Contact us within the 6-month warranty period 2. Provide your repair reference number 3. Describe the fault and when it started 4. We arrange collection within 3 business days A warranty is a promise. We keep our promises. 5. ELECTRICAL, PLUMBING, AND HANDYMAN SERVICE REFUNDS These services are delivered on-site at your home by qualified, certified technicians. They follow different refund rules than appliance repairs because the work happens at your location, not our workshop. 5.1 Electrical Plan Service Refunds Your Electrical Plan is delivered by a registered Installation Electrician (Wireman). Scenario Refund Service call-out completed, fault fixed No refund — service delivered Service call-out completed, fault not fixable on first visit Free follow-up visit at no extra charge Service call-out completed, additional materials needed beyond R1,200 allowance You are quoted before work proceeds. No refund if you approve the quote. Certificate of Compliance issued No refund — CoC is a legal document Technician arrives but cannot access your property No refund — call-out counts as used We fail to send a technician within agreed timeframe Free rescheduling or pro-rata credit towards next annual renewal 5.2 Plumbing Plan Service Refunds Your Plumbing Plan is delivered by a PIRB-registered plumber. Scenario Refund Service call-out completed, fault fixed No refund — service delivered Geyser replacement with PIRB Certificate of Compliance No refund — CoC is a legal document Blocked drain cleared No refund — service delivered Additional materials needed beyond R1,500 allowance You are quoted before work proceeds. No refund if you approve the quote. Emergency isolation provided (burst geyser, flooding) No refund — emergency service delivered We fail to send a plumber within agreed timeframe Free rescheduling or pro-rata credit towards next annual renewal 5.3 Handyman Plan Service Refunds Your Handyman Plan is delivered by skilled maintenance technicians. Scenario Refund Service call-out completed, repair done No refund — service delivered Roof leak diagnosed but requires specialist contractor Referral provided. No refund — diagnosis delivered. Door or window replacement completed No refund — service delivered Additional materials needed beyond R1,500 allowance You are quoted before work proceeds. No refund if you approve the quote. We fail to send a technician within agreed timeframe Free rescheduling or pro-rata credit towards next annual renewal 5.4 Materials Allowance Refunds Each annual plan includes a materials allowance: - Electrical Plan: R1,200 per year for cable, sockets, conduit, fittings - Plumbing Plan: R1,500 per year for tap washers, valve kits, pipe fittings - Handyman Plan: R1,500 per year for putty, sealant, hinges, handles, glass If materials exceed your allowance: - You are quoted before additional materials are ordered - You approve the quote before work proceeds - No refund if you approve and the work is completed - Full refund of additional materials cost if work is not completed due to our error 5.5 Workmanship Warranty (All On-Site Services) All on-site services (Electrical, Plumbing, Handyman) come with a 30-day workmanship warranty . If the same fault recurs within 30 days due to our workmanship: - Free follow-up visit to re-do the work - No additional call-out charge - No additional materials charge if the same materials are used - If re-work is not possible, refund of the service call-out value This does not cover new faults, customer-caused damage, or wear and tear. 6. MASTER PRACTICE MODULES REFUNDS The Master Practice Modules is a 6-month workplace preparation course. Here is how refunds work for each payment. 5.1 Application Fee (R950) The R950 application fee covers the cost of reviewing your application, verifying your documents, and assessing your eligibility. Non-refundable: Once we begin reviewing your application, the fee is non-refundable. This applies whether your application is approved or rejected. Refundable: If we reject your application without reviewing it (for example, if we cancel the programme before processing your application), you receive a full refund. Why this is fair: We invest real time and expertise into every application. Your application is reviewed by a qualified assessor who checks your documents, verifies your eligibility, and makes a fair decision. That work has value regardless of the outcome. 5.2 Registration Fee (R4,000) The R4,000 registration fee is paid after your application is approved. This fee secures your place in the programme and unlocks your Learner Portal access. Full refund: If you pay the registration fee and withdraw within 7 business days before your programme start date, and you have not accessed the Learner Portal or downloaded any course materials. No refund: If you have accessed the Learner Portal, downloaded course materials, or if your programme has already started. 5.3 Monthly Installments (R3,200 per month) Monthly installments are due at the end of each month for 5 months. Refund within first 7 days: If you withdraw within the first 7 days of a month and have not attended any workshops or submitted any evidence, you receive a full refund for that month. Refund after 7 days: If you withdraw after 7 days but before the month ends, you receive a pro-rata refund for the unused portion of the month. For example, if you withdraw on day 15, you receive approximately 50% of that month's installment back. No refund: If you have attended workshops or submitted evidence during the month, no refund is available for that month. Why this is fair: We allocate resources based on your participation. If you participate, the cost is justified. If you do not participate, you should not pay for time you did not use. 5.4 Upfront Payment (R17,500) If you pay the full R17,500 upfront, you receive a R4,000 discount (the registration fee is waived). This payment covers months 1 through 6. Before programme starts: Full refund if you withdraw within 7 business days of payment and have not accessed the Learner Portal. After programme starts: No refund for months already started. If you withdraw mid-programme, you receive a pro-rata refund for months that have not yet begun, calculated based on the number of complete months remaining. 5.5 Program Cancellation by Zibuke OnCall If we cancel the Master Practice Modules programme for any reason: - Full refund of all fees paid, including the application fee - Refund processed within 14 business days - Priority placement in the next available programme if you want to continue 5.6 How MPM Refunds Are Processed Payment Type Refund Method Processing Time Application fee Non-refundable N/A Registration fee Original payment method 14 business days Monthly installment Original payment method 14 business days Upfront payment Original payment method 14 business days 7. DELIVERY AND COLLECTION REFUNDS 7.1 Successful Delivery/Collection Delivery and collection services are non-refundable once completed. There are three exceptions: - Appliance delivered to wrong address (our error) - Appliance damaged during delivery (our responsibility) - Delivery delayed by more than 48 hours from scheduled time If we make a mistake, we fix it. That is the standard we hold ourselves to. 7.2 Cancelled Delivery/Collection If you cancel a scheduled delivery or collection: Cancellation Timeframe Refund More than 24 hours before scheduled time Full refund Less than 24 hours before scheduled time No refund No-show without cancellation No refund We plan our routes and allocate drivers based on your booking. Late cancellations cost us resources we cannot recover. 7.3 Failed Delivery/Collection If we fail to deliver or collect as scheduled because of our error: - Free rescheduling at your convenience - Full refund of delivery/collection fee if service cannot be rescheduled - Compensation if delay exceeds 72 hours Your time matters. When we waste it, we make it right. 8. PAYMENT PAUSE DUE TO INACTIVITY 8.1 Automatic Payment Pause If you have not booked OnCall for 12 consecutive months , your payments will automatically pause. This applies to all plans: - Appliance Repair Plans (Silver, Gold, Platinum) - Electrical Plan - Plumbing Plan - Handyman Plan What payment pause means: - You are not required to make any payments while payments are paused - Your plan stays fully active — you do not lose anything - You can book OnCall at any time, even if you have not paid in years 8.2 Payment Pause by Billing Type Billing Type How Payment Pause Works Monthly (Appliance Plans) If you do not book OnCall for 12 months, monthly payments pause. You owe nothing while paused. When you book OnCall, monthly payments resume and you must pay for the current month before your next booking. Annual (Appliance Plans) If you do not book OnCall for 12 months after your annual period ends, payments pause. No new annual payment is required while paused. When you book OnCall, you must pay for a new annual period before your next booking. Annual (Electrical, Plumbing, Handyman) If you do not book OnCall for 12 months after your annual period ends, payments pause. No new annual payment is required while paused. When you book OnCall, you must pay for a new annual period before your next booking. 8.3 Reactivation on Booking 8.3 Reactivation on Booking When you book OnCall while your payments are paused: - Your payments automatically resume - Payment becomes due before your next booking - You can complete this booking without paying, but you must pay before your next OnCall booking - Your plan continues from where it left off — no new waiting period 8.4 How to Check Your Plan Status You can check if your payments are paused by: - Logging into your Customer Portal at https://zibukeoncall.co.za/my-account.html - Entering your ID number on the Book OnCall page - Contacting us at +27 18 007 0525 8.4 Payment Pause and Refunds - No refund is applicable during a payment pause because no payments are being collected - If you paid annually and your payment pauses mid-year, no refund is due for the remaining months - The pause protects you from paying for time you are not using 9. WAITING PERIOD REFUNDS 8.1 During Waiting Period (First 6 Months) The waiting period is a standard part of all subscription plans and is not eligible for refund . You may cancel your subscription at any time. No refund for the current billing cycle. No further charges after cancellation. The waiting period protects both of us. It ensures new subscribers are committed before claiming repairs, which keeps costs fair for everyone. 8.2 Waiting Period Waiver In exceptional circumstances, we may waive the waiting period. If the waiting period was waived and you later request a refund, the waived waiting period value is deducted from any refund amount. This does not apply if the waiting period was waived as part of a promotional offer. 9. REFUND PROCESSING 9.1 Refund Methods Refunds will be processed using the original payment method : Original Payment Method Refund Method Processing Time Credit/Debit Card (iKoKha) Refund to original card 7-14 business days Instant EFT (iKoKha) Refund to bank account 7-14 business days Bank Transfer Refund to bank account 14-21 business days 9.2 Refund Processing Times Refund Type Processing Time Cooling-off period refund 14 business days Service failure refund 14 business days Warranty claim refund 21 business days Duplicate payment refund 7 business days Overcharge refund 7 business days 9.3 Refund Confirmation You will receive: - Email confirmation when your refund is processed - Refund reference number for tracking - Estimated arrival date for the refund to appear in your account 9.4 Refund Disputes If you believe a refund has been incorrectly processed: 1. Contact us within 30 days of the refund processing date 2. Provide your refund reference number 3. Explain the discrepancy 4. We will investigate and respond within 10 business days 10. HOW TO REQUEST A REFUND 10.1 Online (Recommended) 1. Log into your Customer Portal at https://zibukeoncall.co.za/portal.html 2. Navigate to "My Account" → "Billing" 3. Click "Request Refund" 4. Select the charge you wish to dispute 5. Provide reason for refund request 6. Submit the request 10.2 Email Send your refund request to: [email protected] Include: - Your full name - Account ID (found in your portal or confirmation emails) - Date of payment - Amount to be refunded - Reason for refund request - Any supporting documentation 10.3 Phone Call us at: +27 (0) 11 123 4567 Available: Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM SAST 10.4 In Writing Send a letter to: Zibuke OnCall (Pty) Ltd Refund Department [Physical Address] Johannesburg, South Africa 11. documents.title: Cancellation Policy | Zibuke OnCall
documents.text: Cancellation Policy | Zibuke OnCall ZIBUKE ONCALL | CANCELLATION POLICY Effective Date: January 1, 2026 Last Updated: June 11, 2026 Version: 2.1 1. OVERVIEW This Cancellation Policy explains how to cancel your Zibuke OnCall subscription plan or Master Practice Modules training course. It covers what happens to your services, your payments, and your data when you cancel. Our subscription plans include: - Appliance Repair Plans (Silver, Gold, Platinum) — monthly or annual billing - Electrical Plan — R2,900 per year (annual only) - Plumbing Plan — R3,300 per year (annual only) - Handyman Plan — R3,500 per year (annual only) We believe in being upfront with you. Cancellation should be simple and fair. That is how we would want to be treated, and that is how we treat you. This policy follows the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008 (South Africa). Your statutory rights are always protected. 2. DEFINITIONS Term Definition Subscription Plan Any home services plan purchased by the customer (Appliance Repair Silver/Gold/Platinum, Electrical Plan, Plumbing Plan, or Handyman Plan) Appliance Repair Plan The monthly or annual plan (Silver, Gold, or Platinum) covering appliance collection, repair, and delivery Electrical Plan The annual plan (R2,900/year) covering electrical services by a registered Wireman, up to 8 call-outs per year Plumbing Plan The annual plan (R3,300/year) covering plumbing services by a PIRB-registered plumber, up to 10 call-outs per year Handyman Plan The annual plan (R3,500/year) covering handyman services by skilled technicians, up to 12 call-outs per year Subscription Fee The monthly payment for the chosen repair plan Cancellation The termination of your subscription plan and related services Cooling-Off Period 7 business days from initial subscription payment Notice Period The time between requesting cancellation and the cancellation taking effect Outstanding Bookings Repair services that have been booked but not yet completed Active Repair An appliance currently being repaired at our workshop Warranty Period 6 months from the date of completed repair Waiting Period The first 6 months of subscription during which repairs cannot be booked Master Practice Modules The 6-month workplace preparation course for appliance repair Learner Portal The online platform where MPM learners access course materials and track progress 3. YOUR RIGHT TO CANCEL 3.1 Statutory Right Under the Consumer Protection Act 68 of 2008 , you have the right to cancel a fixed-term agreement: - At any time, with 20 business days' notice - Without penalty, if cancellation is due to our breach of contract - Without penalty, if we materially change the terms of the agreement These are your legal rights. We respect them fully. 3.2 Cooling-Off Period You have 7 business days from your initial subscription payment to cancel your subscription. This applies only if you have not registered any appliances, booked any repair services, requested any services, or used any services. During the cooling-off period: - Full refund of subscription fee - No cancellation fees - Immediate account deactivation We offer this because we want you to feel confident about your decision. If our service is not right for you, you should be able to walk away without losing anything. 3.3 Voluntary Cancellation You may cancel your subscription at any time after the cooling-off period, subject to: - 20 business days' notice - Completion or cancellation of outstanding bookings - Return of any appliances currently in our possession - Settlement of any outstanding payments 4. CANCELLATION PROCESS 4.1 How to Cancel You may cancel your subscription using any of the following methods: Method 1: Online (Recommended) 1. Log into your Customer Portal at https://zibukeoncall.co.za/portal.html 2. Navigate to "My Account" → "Subscription" 3. Click "Cancel Subscription" 4. Select your reason for cancellation 5. Confirm cancellation request 6. Receive confirmation email Method 2: Email Send your cancellation request to: [email protected] Include: - Your full name - Account ID (found in your portal or confirmation emails) - Subscription plan (Silver, Gold, or Platinum) - Date you wish cancellation to take effect - Reason for cancellation (optional) Method 3: Phone Call us at: +27 (0) 11 123 4567 Available: Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM SAST Method 4: In Writing Send a letter to: Zibuke OnCall (Pty) Ltd Cancellation Department [Physical Address] Johannesburg, South Africa 4.2 Cancellation Confirmation Within 3 business days of receiving your cancellation request, we will: 1. Send you a cancellation confirmation email 2. Provide your cancellation reference number 3. Outline the next steps and any outstanding requirements 4. Confirm the effective cancellation date 4.3 Cancellation Effective Date Cancellation Scenario Effective Date Cooling-off period (7 days) Immediate Voluntary cancellation 20 business days after request Cancellation due to our breach Immediate Cancellation due to material change Immediate Outstanding bookings pending After completion or cancellation of bookings 5. ANNUAL HOME SERVICES PLAN CANCELLATION (Electrical, Plumbing, Handyman) The Electrical Plan, Plumbing Plan, and Handyman Plan are annual-only subscriptions with no monthly billing option. These plans provide on-site services at your home by qualified, certified technicians. 5.1 Cooling-Off Period You have 7 business days from your annual payment to cancel for a full refund, provided no service call-outs have been booked or completed. 5.2 Cancellation After Cooling-Off Period If you cancel after the 7-day cooling-off period: - No refund for the current annual period - No cancellation fee - Your plan remains active until the end of the annual period - You may continue to use remaining service call-outs until cancellation takes effect - No renewal — your plan will not auto-renew 5.3 Outstanding Service Call-Outs If you have outstanding service call-outs at the time of cancellation: Status Action Call-out booked but not yet attended Cancelled at your request, or completed if technician is already dispatched Technician dispatched to your home Service completed. Call-out counts as used. Work in progress at your home Work completed. Materials used from your allowance. Follow-up visit scheduled Cancelled at your request 5.4 What Happens to Your Service Benefits Benefit Status After Cancellation Remaining service call-outs Available until annual period ends Materials allowance Available until annual period ends Certificate of Compliance Issued certificates remain valid Workmanship warranty (30 days) Continues for remaining warranty period on completed work Plan renewal Will not renew at end of annual period 5.5 How to Cancel an Annual Home Services Plan You may cancel using any of these methods: Online: Log into your Customer Portal at https://zibukeoncall.co.za/my-account.html, navigate to your subscription, and click Cancel. Email: Send your cancellation to [email protected] with your full name, account ID, plan name, and reason for cancellation. Phone: Call +27 18 007 0525 during business hours (Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM SAST). 6. WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU CANCEL 5.1 Subscription Benefits When your cancellation takes effect: Benefit Status After Cancellation Access to Customer Portal Deactivated after 30 days Repair services No longer available Collection and delivery services No longer available Appliance registration Deactivated New bookings Cannot be made Warranty on existing repairs Continues for remaining warranty period Your warranty on repairs already completed does not disappear when you cancel. We stand behind our work regardless of your subscription status. 5.2 Registered Appliances When you cancel your subscription: - Your registered appliances remain in our system for record-keeping - You cannot register new appliances after cancellation - Your appliance repair history is preserved for warranty service requests - You may reactivate your subscription within 12 months without re-registering appliances We do not delete your history. If you come back, you pick up where you left off. 5.3 Outstanding Bookings If you have outstanding bookings at the time of cancellation: Booking Status Action Booked but not started Cancelled at your request Appliance collected, awaiting diagnosis Diagnosis completed, quotation provided Appliance in workshop, diagnosis complete Quotation provided, you decide whether to proceed Appliance being repaired Repair completed and delivered Appliance awaiting delivery Delivered to your address You are responsible for: - Deciding whether to proceed with repairs after diagnosis - Paying for any repairs already in progress - Paying delivery costs for any appliances collected 5.4 Active Repairs If an appliance is currently being repaired when you cancel: 1. We will complete the repair and deliver the appliance 2. You will be charged for the repair (delivery + labour + parts) 3. The 6-month warranty applies from the date of delivery 4. You may request warranty service during the warranty period even after cancellation 5.5 Waiting Period If you cancel during the waiting period (first 6 months): - No refund for the current billing cycle - No refund for the waiting period already served - If you reactivate within 12 months, the waiting period continues from where it left off - If you reactivate after 12 months, a new waiting period begins 6. MASTER PRACTICE MODULES CANCELLATION The Master Practice Modules is a 6-month workplace preparation course. Here is how cancellation works. 6.1 Before the Programme Starts If you cancel before your programme start date: - Within 7 business days of registration payment: Full refund of the registration fee (R4,000 or R17,500 if paid upfront). No questions asked. - After 7 business days but before start date: No refund of the registration fee. Your Learner Portal access will be deactivated. - Application fee (R950): Non-refundable in all cases. The work of reviewing your application was already done. 6.2 During the Programme If you cancel while the programme is in progress: - Current month's installment (R3,200): Non-refundable. Your Master Craftsman has already committed time and resources for this month. - Future months: No further charges will be applied. If you paid upfront, you may be eligible for a pro-rata refund for months that have not yet started. - Learner Portal access: Deactivated at the end of the current month. - Evidence and progress: Your uploaded evidence and progress records are preserved for 12 months in case you want to re-enrol. 6.3 Cancellation by Zibuke OnCall If we cancel the programme for any reason: - Full refund of all fees paid, including the application fee - Refund processed within 14 business days - Priority placement in the next available programme if you want to continue - All your evidence and progress records are preserved and transferred to the new programme 6.4 How to Cancel Your MPM Enrolment You may cancel using any of these methods: Online: Log into your Learner Portal and click "Withdraw from Programme" under Account Settings. Email: Send your cancellation to [email protected] with your full name, learner reference number, and reason for cancellation. Phone: Call +27 (0) 11 123 4567 during business hours (Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM SAST). 6.5 What Happens to Your Evidence When you cancel your MPM enrolment: - Evidence you uploaded (photos, notes, voice recordings) is preserved for 12 months - Progress records are preserved for 12 months - If you re-enrol within 12 months: Your evidence and progress are restored - If you re-enrol after 12 months: You start fresh. Previous evidence is not recoverable. 6.6 Re-enrolment After Cancellation If you cancel and want to re-enrol: - Within 12 months: You can re-enrol without paying the application fee again. Your evidence and progress are restored. You pick up where you left off. - After 12 months: You must submit a new application and pay the application fee again. Previous evidence is not recoverable. 7. CANCELLATION FEES 7.1 No Cancellation Fees We do not charge cancellation fees for: - Cancellation during the cooling-off period - Cancellation due to our breach of contract - Cancellation due to material change in terms - Cancellation after completing the minimum subscription period (if applicable) We do not believe in trapping you with fees. If you want to leave, you should be able to leave. 6.2 Outstanding Payments You are responsible for any outstanding payments at the time of cancellation: Outstanding Payment When Due Current month's subscription Immediately Repair costs (in progress) Upon completion of repair Delivery costs (collected appliances) Upon delivery Parts already ordered Immediately 6.3 Early Termination If you cancel before completing a minimum subscription period (if applicable): - No early termination fee if no minimum period was agreed - Pro-rata refund for unused portion of prepaid subscriptions - No refund for the current billing cycle 8. PAYMENT PAUSE DUE TO INACTIVITY 8.1 Automatic Payment Pause If you have not booked OnCall for 12 consecutive months , your payments will automatically pause. This applies to all plans: - Appliance Repair Plans (Silver, Gold, Platinum) - Electrical Plan - Plumbing Plan - Handyman Plan What payment pause means: - You are not required to make any payments while payments are paused - Your plan stays fully active — you do not lose anything - You can book OnCall at any time, even if you have not paid in years 8.2 Payment Pause by Billing Type Billing Type How Payment Pause Works Monthly (Appliance Plans) If you do not book OnCall for 12 months, monthly payments pause. You owe nothing while paused. When you book OnCall, monthly payments resume and you must pay for the current month before your next booking. Annual (Appliance Plans) If you do not book OnCall for 12 months after your annual period ends, payments pause. No new annual payment is required while paused. When you book OnCall, you must pay for a new annual period before your next booking. Annual (Electrical, Plumbing, Handyman) If you do not book OnCall for 12 months after your annual period ends, payments pause. No new annual payment is required while paused. When you book OnCall, you must pay for a new annual period before your next booking. 8.3 Reactivation on Booking 8.3 Reactivation on Booking When you book OnCall while your payments are paused: - Your payments automatically resume - Payment becomes due before your next booking - You can complete this booking without paying, but you must pay before your next OnCall booking - Your plan continues from where it left off — no new waiting period - No reactivation fee is charged 8.4 How to Check Your Plan Status You can check if your payments are paused by: - Logging into your Customer Portal at https://zibukeoncall.co.za/my-account.html - Entering your ID number on the Book OnCall page - Contacting us at +27 18 007 0525 8.4 Payment Pause vs Cancellation Aspect Payment Pause Cancellation Payments Not required while payments are paused No further payments after cancellation Plan right Plan stays fully active — you lose nothing Lost — you no longer have a plan Reactivation Automatic when you book OnCall Must re-subscribe within 12 months or start fresh Waiting period No new waiting period Waiting period continues if reactivated within 12 months Appliance registration Preserved Preserved for 12 months Warranty on past repairs Continues Continues for remaining warranty period 9. REACTIVATION 8.1 Reactivation Within 12 Months If you want to reactivate your subscription within 12 months of cancellation: 1. Log into your Customer Portal (if account is still active) 2. Navigate to "My Account" then "Subscription" 3. Click "Reactivate Subscription" 4. Select your new plan (if different from previous) 5. Complete payment for the first month Benefits of reactivation within 12 months: - No need to re-register appliances - Waiting period continues from where it left off - Appliance history preserved - Existing warranty service requests honored We remember you. Your history stays with us. 8.2 Reactivation After 12 Months If you want to reactivate your subscription after 12 months : 1. You must create a new account 2. You must re-register all appliances 3. A new waiting period begins 4. Previous appliance history is not carried over 5. Previous warranty service requests are not honored After 12 months, we start fresh together. This protects both of us from outdated information. 8.3 Reactivation Fees We do not charge reactivation fees. However: - You must pay the first month's subscription at the time of reactivation - Any outstanding payments from previous subscription must be settled - If you had outstanding bookings at cancellation, these must be resolved We do not penalize you for coming back. We welcome it. 9. CANCELLATION SCENARIOS 8.1 Customer-Initiated Cancellation Scenario Refund Fees Waiting Period Cooling-off period (7 days, no services) Full refund None N/A After cooling-off, no services used No refund for current month None Continues if reactivated within 12 months Outstanding bookings pending No refund for current month Outstanding repair/delivery costs Continues if reactivated within 12 months Active repair in progress No refund for current month Repair costs Continues if reactivated within 12 months 8.2 Our-Initiated Cancellation We may cancel your subscription in the following circumstances: Scenario Notice Refund Fees Non-payment (3 months) 30 days No refund Outstanding payments due Fraudulent activity Immediate No refund None Violation of Terms of Service 30 days Pro-rata refund None Service discontinuation 90 days Pro-rata refund None 8.3 Force Majeure Cancellation If services are cancelled due to force majeure (natural disasters, pandemics, etc.): - 90 days' notice if possible - Pro-rata refund for unused subscription period - No cancellation fees - Priority reactivation when services resume 10. WARRANTY AFTER CANCELLATION 10.1 Existing Warranty Claims If you have an active warranty claim at the time of cancellation: - The warranty period continues for the remaining duration - You may request warranty service during the warranty period - No subscription required to request warranty service on existing repairs - Free re-repair if the same fault recurs during warranty period Your warranty is a promise we made when we repaired your appliance. Cancelling your subscription does not break that promise. 10.2 Warranty Claim Process After Cancellation 1. Contact us within the 6-month warranty period 2. Provide your repair reference number 3. Describe the fault and when it started 4. We arrange collection within 3 business days 5. No subscription required for warranty service requests We honour our warranties even after you leave. That is accountability. 9.3 Warranty Expiration When the warranty period expires: - No further service requests can be made - No subscription required for warranty service requests during the warranty period - No subscription required to receive warranty service 11. DATA RETENTION AFTER CANCELLATION 10.1 Data Retention Period After cancellation, we retain your data as follows: Data Type Retention Period Account information 12 months Appliance registration 12 months Repair history 5 years Warranty records 5 years Payment records 5 years Communication records 2 years 10.2 Data Deletion After the retention period: - Account information is deleted - Appliance registration is deleted - Repair history is archived (anonymized) - Warranty records are archived (anonymized) - Payment records are retained for legal compliance - Communication records are deleted 10.3 Data Access After Cancellation During the retention period, you may: - Request access to your data - Request correction of inaccurate data - Request deletion of data (subject to legal requirements) - Export your data in a portable format 12. SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES 12.1 Bereavement In the event of a customer's death: 1. Immediate family members may request account closure 2. Outstanding balances are written off based on documented circumstances 3. Any appliances in our possession are returned to the estate 4. No cancellation fees apply 5. Pro-rata refund for unused subscription (if applicable) Required documentation: - Death certificate - Proof of relationship - Estate documentation (if applicable) We handle these situations with the sensitivity they deserve. Grief is hard enough without bureaucratic obstacles. 12.2 Financial Hardship If you are experiencing financial hardship: - Contact us to discuss reduced rates or payment plans - We may offer subscription suspension (up to 3 months) - No cancellation fees for hardship-related cancellations - Priority reactivation when financial situation improves We understand that life happens. We would rather help you through a difficult time than lose you as a customer. 12.3 Medical Emergencies If you cannot use our services due to a medical emergency: - Contact us with medical documentation - We may offer subscription suspension (up to 6 months) - No cancellation fees for medical-related cancellations - Priority reactivation when you are able to use services again Your health comes first. We work around your situation, not the other way around. 12.4 Relocation If you are relocating outside our service area: - Contact us with your new address - We confirm if services are available in your new area - If services are not available , we process cancellation - No cancellation fees for relocation-related cancellations - Pro-rata refund for unused subscription (if applicable) Moving is stressful enough. We make the cancellation part as simple as possible. 13. DISPUTE RESOLUTION 12.1 Internal Resolution If you are not satisfied with our cancellation decision: 1. Request a review by our Customer Service Manager 2. Provide additional documentation or evidence 3. We will respond within 15 business days 12.2 External Resolution If internal resolution is unsuccessful: - Consumer Goods and Services Ombud: https://cgso.org.za - National Consumer Commission: https://thencc.gov.za - Small Claims Court: For claims under R20,000 - Consumer Protection Act: You have the right to approach the Consumer Tribunal 12.3 Legal Proceedings This policy does not prevent you from: - Seeking legal advice - Approaching the Consumer Tribunal - Exercising your rights under the Consumer Protection Act 14. CONTACT INFORMATION Channel Details Email [email protected] Phone +27 (0) 11 123 4567 Hours Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM SAST Website https://zibukeoncall.co.za Portal https://zibukeoncall.co.za/portal.html 15. DATA PROTECTION AND POPIA COMPLIANCE We process your personal information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA). 15.1 What Data We Collect We collect only the data necessary to provide our services: Data Type Purpose Name and contact details To communicate with you about your subscription or course Payment information To process payments and refunds Appliance details To provide repair services Repair history To honour warranties and provide quality service Course progress and evidence To assess your learning and provide feedback Communication records To resolve disputes and improve service 15.2 How We Use Your Data We use your data only for the purposes you consented to: - To provide the services you requested - To process payments and refunds - To communicate about your account - To comply with legal obligations - To improve our services (with your consent) We do not sell your data to third parties. documents.text: Regional Sales Manager | Zibuke OnCall Corporate Services 📞 Enquiries: +27 18 007 0525 📍 Contact Us 📋 Package Plans Now Hiring Regional Sales Manager Sell corporate maintenance contracts worth R20,000 or more per month to insurance companies, property managers, and retailers across South Africa. Earn a R32,000 monthly salary plus commission and annual bonuses. Prove yourself by generating R100,000 in monthly revenue during your Accountability Assessment. The Role You are the bridge between Zibuke OnCall's corporate maintenance capability and the corporations that need us. Your job is to find companies that maintain physical infrastructure, show them how our fixed monthly retainer eliminates their maintenance chaos, and close contracts worth R20,000 or more per month. You will sell to insurance companies that process thousands of appliance claims. You will sell to property management companies that oversee hundreds of rental units. You will sell to retailers that need consistent warranty service across all their stores. You will sell to hotels, hospitals, and schools that cannot afford maintenance failures. This is a remote role. You work from your car, from coffee shops, from client offices. You manage your own schedule. You set your own meetings. You close your own deals. The only thing that matters is results. What You Earn Component Amount Details Monthly Salary R32,000 Paid on the 25th of every month Commission Percentage of contract value Earned on every corporate contract you close Annual Bonus Based on accountability score Bars earned above monthly targets accumulate for annual bonus UIF Included Unemployment Insurance Fund contributions made by Zibuke OnCall Medical Benefits Available Medical aid options available after passing assessment Your total earnings depend on the contracts you close. The R32,000 salary is your base. Commission and bonuses are earned on top of that. A Regional Sales Manager who closes five corporate contracts at R20,000 each per month is generating R100,000 in revenue and earning significantly more than the base salary. The Accountability Assessment Before you are hired as a permanent employee, you must prove yourself through real work. This is how we know you belong here, and this is how you know the people around you earned their place too. Your Target: R100,000 in Monthly Revenue You must generate R100,000 per month in corporate contract revenue within your assessment period. This means closing and maintaining corporate contracts that collectively pay Zibuke OnCall R100,000 per month. Five contracts at R20,000 per month each equals R100,000 Three contracts at R33,000 per month each equals R99,000 (passes) Two contracts at R50,000 per month each equals R100,000 One contract at R100,000 per month equals R100,000 Any combination that reaches R100,000 in total monthly contract revenue passes the assessment. The contracts must be signed, active, and generating revenue. Verbal agreements and proposals in progress do not count. Assessment Duration You have three months to reach R100,000 in monthly revenue. This gives you enough time to prospect, meet decision makers, run site assessments, submit proposals, and close deals. Corporate sales cycles typically run four to eight weeks, so you need to start strong from day one. What Happens If You Pass You become a permanent Regional Sales Manager at Zibuke OnCall. You receive your R32,000 monthly salary, your commission on every contract you close, your annual bonus based on your accountability score bars, UIF contributions, and access to medical benefits. You continue selling and growing your portfolio of corporate clients. What Happens If You Do Not Pass If you do not reach R100,000 in monthly revenue within three months, your assessment is not renewed. We do not extend assessments. We do not offer second chances. This is not because we do not believe in you. It is because the corporate clients you would have signed are depending on us to deliver a service we promised. If you cannot sell the contracts, we cannot deliver the service, and the client suffers. We protect our clients by only hiring people who can bring them to us. What You Need Previous Experience You must have previous experience selling to corporate accounts or previous work as a real estate agent. We are not looking for retail sales experience or call centre experience. We are looking for people who have sat across the table from a decision maker at a corporation, understood their problem, presented a solution, and closed a deal worth tens of thousands of rands per month. If you have sold commercial property, enterprise software, business services, insurance products, or any other product or service to corporate buyers, you have the right experience. If you have worked as a real estate agent negotiating property deals, you have the right experience. If your sales experience is limited to consumer products or one off transactions, this role is not for you. Your Own Reliable Car This role is remote and on the road. You will drive to client meetings, site assessments, and industry events across your region. You need a reliable car that you own. We do not provide company vehicles. We do not reimburse car payments. We do contribute toward fuel costs for client visits, but the car must be yours and it must be reliable. Other Requirements You must be a South African citizen or permanent resident You must have a valid South African driver's licence You must have a smartphone with data for email, messaging, and video calls You must be based in a major metro area with access to corporate clients You must be comfortable working independently without daily supervision Who You Sell To Your target clients are corporations that maintain physical infrastructure and currently spend significant amounts on maintenance through fragmented, unpredictable vendor relationships. These are the sectors where the need is greatest and the contracts are largest. Insurance Companies Insurance companies process thousands of appliance claims every year. Each claim requires finding a repair vendor, negotiating a price, coordinating collection, tracking the repair, and processing the invoice. You show them how Zibuke OnCall becomes the single repair partner for all claims in a region. One partner, one invoice, predictable costs. Contract values range from R20,000 to R150,000 per month. Property Management Companies Property managers oversee portfolios of rental properties with constant plumbing, electrical, and appliance maintenance needs. They manage four to six separate vendors and spend ten to twenty hours every week coordinating maintenance. You show them how Zibuke OnCall handles all four trades under one contract. Contract values range from R20,000 to R200,000 per month. Retailers Retailers that sell appliances and electronics have warranty obligations to every customer. Most outsource warranty repairs to independent shops with inconsistent quality and variable pricing. You show them how Zibuke OnCall becomes the warranty service partner with consistent quality and predictable costs. Contract values range from R20,000 to R100,000 per month. Hospitality, Healthcare, and Education Hotels, hospitals, and schools maintain large facilities with critical maintenance needs. A broken air conditioner in a hotel room, a failed refrigerator in a hospital, or a burst geyser in a school creates immediate problems. You show them how Zibuke OnCall provides rapid response and preventive maintenance under a fixed monthly retainer. Contract values range from R20,000 to R300,000 per month. How You Sell Selling corporate maintenance contracts is not like selling a product off a shelf. It is a process that requires patience, empathy, and genuine understanding of the client's world. Step One: Find the Right Prospect You identify corporations that maintain physical assets across multiple sites, currently spend at least R15,000 per month on maintenance, experience unpredictable costs, and have a decision maker with authority to sign a monthly retainer contract. If a prospect does not meet these criteria, you do not sell to them. Step Two: Research Before You Call You spend thirty minutes researching the prospect before you make contact. You understand their business model, their customers, and their challenges. When you finally speak to the decision maker, you demonstrate within the first two minutes that you understand their industry and their specific problems. Step Three: Listen More Than You Talk Your first conversation is eighty percent listening and twenty percent talking. You ask about their current maintenance situation, their pain points, and their goals. You document every answer because these exact words become the foundation of your proposal. Step Four: Visit Their Sites You offer a free site assessment. You walk their facilities with their team. You document their assets. You identify risks they have overlooked. You demonstrate expertise that builds trust. Step Five: Write a Proposal in Their Language You translate every feature of our service into a benefit that matters to their business. You use their own words from the discovery conversation. You show them projected cost savings and measurable outcomes. Step Six: Close by Talking About Outcomes You focus on budget certainty, time savings, customer satisfaction, compliance, and peace of mind. You frame the decision in terms of the costs they are already incurring and the chaos they are already experiencing. Step Seven: Follow Up with Patience Most corporate deals close after three to five meaningful interactions. You follow up with value at every touchpoint. You never pressure. You build trust over time. The Signalling Selling Approach Signalling is a selling approach where you test if there is a need for maintenance problems at a potential corporate prospect by sending an email that offers a free comprehensive maintenance assessment report . This is done for free. If they agree, you request a template to use to collect information from the customer. This allows us to understand the customer and their needs better and to create the report for them. Step-by-Step Process Identify the prospect — must meet the qualification criteria (10+ appliances or 5+ properties, currently spending R15K+/month on maintenance, at least 1 maintenance emergency in the past 6 months, decision maker with R20K+/month budget authority). Research the prospect before reaching out. Send the signalling email offering a free comprehensive maintenance assessment. If they agree , request permission to collect information using the assessment template. Collect the information from the customer. Send the collected information to the Zibuke OnCall technical team, who produce two documents: (a) the comprehensive maintenance assessment report for the customer, and (b) a set of customised educational emails that you send to the prospect to build trust. Send the assessment report to the customer and begin the educational email sequence. If the customer wants a quote on a maintenance contract, visit at least one site of the client and get managers at other sites to collect needed information virtually. You carry another template of all the information required about the customer. Once collected , the information is sent to the Zibuke OnCall technical team that writes a contract. Once done , the contract is sent to you, and you send it to the customer. You also get another document that will help you close that deal. Five-Sentence Email Examples Short, professional, approachable emails that follow the signalling approach: Example 1: Dear [Name], I noticed [Company] manages a significant property portfolio in [Area]. Unexpected maintenance failures can cost businesses thousands in emergency callouts and downtime. We offer a free comprehensive maintenance assessment that identifies risks before they become costly problems. Our assessment is completely free and comes with no obligation. Would you be open to a brief call to discuss how this could benefit [Company]? Example 2: Dear [Name], I read that [Company] recently expanded its operations in [Area]. With growth comes increased maintenance responsibilities that can strain budgets if not managed proactively. We provide a free comprehensive maintenance assessment that helps businesses understand their maintenance risks and costs. The report is yours to keep whether you work with us or not. Could I send you more information about the assessment? Example 3: Dear [Name], Many [Industry] companies in South Africa spend 3 to 10 times more on reactive maintenance than preventive maintenance. Our free comprehensive maintenance assessment identifies where your maintenance spend is going and where you can save. The assessment covers all four maintenance trades: appliances, plumbing, electrical, and handyman. There is no cost and no obligation. Would you like to schedule a brief conversation? Example 4: Dear [Name], I understand that managing maintenance across multiple sites is a challenge that takes time away from your core business. Our free comprehensive maintenance assessment gives you a clear picture of your entire maintenance landscape in one report. We cover appliances, plumbing, electrical, and handyman services under one assessment. The assessment is free and the report is yours to keep. Can I send you a sample of what the report includes? Example 5: Dear [Name], A single maintenance emergency can cost your business more than an entire month of preventive maintenance. Our free comprehensive maintenance assessment helps you identify potential failures before they happen, saving you money and downtime. We specialise in covering all four maintenance trades under one contract. The assessment is free, takes minimal time, and provides actionable insights. Would you be available for a 10-minute call this week? How Corporate Maintenance Contracts Work A corporate maintenance contract is a fixed monthly retainer that covers all maintenance needs for a corporate customer across four service categories: Appliance Repair and Maintenance, Plumbing Maintenance and Repair, Electrical Maintenance and Repair, and Handyman and General Facility Maintenance. The Landscape Plan is a homeowner-only service and is not offered as part of corporate maintenance contracts. Minimum contract: R20,000/month, 12-month commitment. Mobile Service: technicians on specific days per week, within 24-hour response, minimum R20K/month. Stationed Service: dedicated technician on-site during business hours, minimum R45K/month. Retainer Tiers Essentials (R20K-R35K): 1 service category, 2 days/week on-site, 24-hour response. Professional (R35K-R75K): 2-3 categories, 3-5 days/week, 12-hour response. Enterprise (R75K-R200K): all 4 categories, 5 days/week, 4-hour critical response. Strategic Partnership (R200K+): fully customised, custom SLA. ⏱ The 3-Hour Emergency Response Guarantee: Onsite within 3 hours of first report throughout South Africa for any asset under the maintenance contract. Contract terms: Monthly in advance, CPI-linked escalation capped at 8%, 90-day cancellation notice after initial 12 months, 5% credit per SLA breach capped at 20%/month. Qualification Criteria for Corporate Prospects Pursue a prospect only if ALL of these are met: 10+ appliances or 5+ properties Currently spending R15K+/month on maintenance At least 1 maintenance emergency in the past 6 months Decision maker with R20K+/month budget authority Willing to commit to a 12-month minimum Red flags — do NOT pursue: Fewer than 5 units/sites Currently spending less than R10K/month No access to decision maker Reactive mindset only Immediate price focus No business impact from maintenance failures Objection Handling for Corporate Sales "Too expensive" — Redirect to current spend on callout fees and emergency repairs. "Already have staff" — Complement with specialist overflow and preventive maintenance. "We will call when something breaks" — Reactive costs 40-60% more than preventive. "Need to think about it" — Address specific concerns directly. "Tried before and it did not work" — Address scope, response, and understanding gaps. "Can we do a trial?" — Offer 12-month contract with 90-day review instead. This Role Is For You If You have sold to corporate decision makers before and you know how long it takes to close a deal worth R20,000 or more per month You have worked as a real estate agent and you understand how to negotiate contracts, manage client relationships, and close deals under pressure You own a reliable car and you are comfortable spending most of your working day on the road You are self motivated and you do not need someone looking over your shoulder to stay productive You handle rejection well and you understand that a no today can become a yes in six months You want to earn more than R32,000 per month and you are willing to put in the work to close the contracts that generate commission and bonuses This Role Is Not For You If Your sales experience is limited to consumer products, retail, or call centre work You have never sat across the table from a corporate decision maker and closed a deal You do not own a reliable car or you are not comfortable working on the road You need daily supervision, hand holding, or constant motivation from a manager You are looking for a guaranteed income without having to prove yourself through results You are not willing to accept that the Accountability Assessment has a clear pass or fail outcome with no extensions Apply Now If you have the experience, the car, and the drive to sell corporate maintenance contracts across South Africa, apply below. Complete the form honestly. We verify everything. ✓ Application Submitted We have received your application for Regional Sales Manager. Check your email for next steps. If you do not receive an email within 24 hours, check your spam folder or contact us. ← Back to All Jobs
